raw.story:
You dock at Mera Sanctum Station. Archon Mera's concealed base. Quiet, organized, and dangerous.

The pens at Mera Sanctum Station are working hard, crews mustering and dispersing. You don't see the Sanctum's guns until they want you to. From the cockpit you count a single Eviction Notice queued along the shadowed raider pens, a couple of small ships swarming in and out of the silent launch slips, Last Calls trading the lanes with Hostile Takeovers, and twin Start Prayings ferrying crews through the same bays. Racked in the slips, ten or twelve gunships sit fueled and waiting for crews. The racks even hold a solitary No Exit, captured and too big to fence quickly. Not everyone here is crew — you also spot a lone Reclaim threading the silent launch slips and several light craft ferrying crews through the same slips, Futures and Ledgers the most common. The reserve berths hold the better part of a hundred hulls of every stripe powered down over at the hidden captured-hull yards. Conspicuous among them, a lone No Exit — hulls worth more as collateral than as ships. One familiar name stands out on the transponder net: the Drone Core B002.

The station has the following facilities: Commerce Hub, Naval Yard, Maintenance Deck, Contract Office, Package Logistics Bay, Cargo Container Fabricator, Salvage Dock, Fuel Depot, Fuel Bunker, H2 Fuel Combustor, Hydrogen Compression Cylinder, Storage Bay, Iron Refinery, Alloy Foundry, Copper Wire Mill, Plate Press, Weapon Housing Fabrication Line, Fuel Reclamation Still (x2), Weapons Salvage Bench, Scrap Armor Forge, Stolen Reactor Core, Pirate Life Support Rig, Pirate Bar, The Mint, Pirate Crew Muster, Pirate Sawbones Ward, and 35 more. public_facilities.description: A jury-rigged chemical line for cooking gutter flux out of chlorine compounds. The coolant loops keep the reactions from running away and the recyclers fight a losing battle with the fumes. Only the pirate strongholds will let you bolt one of these to their hull.
public_facilities.name: Backstreet Chem Lab

public_facilities.description: An airtight compartment where nebular gas and gutter flux are coaxed into void dust. The recyclers scrub the air and the sensor arrays watch the reaction, because one misread and the room is condemned. Pirate stations only.
public_facilities.name: Sealed Dust Lab

public_facilities.description: A dual-feed pressurization line that mixes and compresses liquid hydrogen and oxygen into stable fuel reserves. Basic control nodes manage stoichiometric ratios and containment pressure.
public_facilities.name: Peroxide Reaction Cell

public_facilities.description: A bootleg distillery built around a sprawl of copper condensation coils, fed by melted water ice and pharmaceutical cultures. The fermentation chambers smell like a chemical fire. Pirate stations only — no licensed dock will let you run one.
public_facilities.name: Backwater Still

public_facilities.description: A premium operation that grinds energy crystals into moonshine and ages the result in low-gravity chambers until the suspension stabilizes into starshine. The sensor arrays guard the glow. Restricted to pirate strongholds.
public_facilities.name: Crystal Infusion Still

public_facilities.description: A salvage-yard still that renders scrap metal and wreck components into workable fuel cells. Smells terrible. Works fine.
public_facilities.name: Fuel Reclamation Still

public_facilities.description: An armory line that forges ghost rounds with every maker's mark and energy signature deliberately omitted. The weapon housings and barrel assemblies are sourced through channels that don't keep records. Pirate stations only.
public_facilities.name: Unmarked Munitions Line

public_facilities.description: A pressure-crystallization rig for bonding plasma gas to gutter flux into nerve burn. The coolant loops and heat sinks manage a process that is as dangerous to make as it is to take. Buildable only at pirate strongholds.
public_facilities.name: Stim Synthesis Lab

public_facilities.description: A repackaging line that strips copper wiring and wraps it around plasma canisters to crank out hot cells. The heat sinks are the only thing standing between you and a casing rupture. Restricted to pirate strongholds.
public_facilities.name: Bootleg Cell Shop

public_facilities.description: A sealed bay that refines gutter flux into synthetic adrenaline and loads it into single-use red mist injectors. The medical modules handle the dosing, which is not adjustable by design. Buildable only at pirate stations.
public_facilities.name: Injector Loading Bay

station_facilities.description: A compact freight-handling bay with container seals, manifest scanners, and automated pallet movers for rapid package assembly and breakdown. Even this entry-level installation works substantially faster than hand unpacking at a workshop.
station_facilities.name: Package Logistics Bay

station_facilities.description: Warm, humid orchard cells ripening sugar-heavy honeyglobe under full-spectrum lamps.
station_facilities.name: Honeyglobe Orchard

station_facilities.description: Secure personal storage lockers for visiting pilots. Locker seals hold firm. The bay is clean, climate-controlled, and organized by section.
station_facilities.name: Storage Bay

station_facilities.description: A recycler unit pulled from a derelict and patched into the station's life support. Scales up everything — capacity, water draw, ice draw, the whole supply chain that feeds the primary. The unit is processing. It takes its cut of the supply lines and the air in the expanded sections is, by local standards, fine.

station_facilities.description: Fuel storage and dispensing facility for visiting ships. Fuel lines pressurized and ready. Ships dock, fill up, and depart with minimal wait.
station_facilities.name: Fuel Depot

station_facilities.description: A wall of mismatched ship batteries — fleet surplus, prize cargo, things found floating — chained in parallel and jury-rigged to the power bus. It works. Mostly. station_facilities.description: A precision cutting bench for the cloudy geode-crystal a ranched druse grows in its gut. station_facilities.description: Full-service trading center with dedicated broker terminals and escrow services. Today, though, broker terminals cycle through error screens. Escrow settlement is backed up, and traders argue over stale quotes.

station_facilities.description: Layered ablative plate welded over the station's structural frame. The crew do not watch the target; they watch the reload clock, and they are patient about it.

raw.story:
You dock at Crix Stronghold Station. Sovereign Crix's well-run base. Surprisingly orderly for pirates.

The pens at Crix Stronghold Station are working hard, crews mustering and dispersing. Half the ships here wear scorch marks and somebody else's paint. The traffic-control feed lists a pair of Asset Forfeitures berthed at the raider pens, racked in neat rows, several small ships darting between the disciplined launch slips, mostly Close Enoughs, and twin Start Prayings puttering around the same lanes. In the pens, four or five gunships are kept ready for the next run. Among the outsiders, just one Junk Convoy discharging holds at the well-kept prize-ship berths and half a dozen light craft shuttling in and out of the disciplined launch slips, Futures and Prospects among them. Station records also account for a handful of ships laid up across the inventoried captured-hull yards.

The station has the following facilities: Commerce Hub, Naval Yard, Maintenance Deck, Contract Office, Package Logistics Bay, Cargo Container Fabricator, Salvage Dock, Fuel Depot, Fuel Bunker, H2 Fuel Combustor, Hydrogen Compression Cylinder, Storage Bay, Iron Refinery, Alloy Foundry, Copper Wire Mill, Plate Press, Weapon Housing Fabrication Line, Fuel Reclamation Still, Weapons Salvage Bench, Scrap Armor Forge, Stolen Reactor Core, Pirate Life Support Rig, Pirate Bar, The Synthesis Bay, Pirate Crew Muster, Pirate Sawbones Ward, and 16 more. raw.story:
You dock at Sable Port Station. Director Sable's operation. Professional, cold, and profitable.

Sable Port Station simmers, a few raiders idling at the markers between runs. Director Sable's operation is professional, cold, and profitable. The docking net shows a single Liquidation idling beside the businesslike raider pens. Racked in the slips, a dozen prize-ships are kept ready for the next run. Bigger prizes lurk among them — a lone Off the Books, too heavy to crew on a whim. Riskier company keeps berths here as well: a handful of light craft bobbing at the efficient launch slips, Archimedes and Futures the most common. The impound registry counts well over a dozen craft cold and dormant along the ledgered captured-hull yards. Conspicuous among them, one lonely Off the Books — too costly to keep crewed, their reactors long cold.

Dock authority holds a pair of vessels laid up tucked into the vast captured-hull yards everyone else copies. The Drone Core D004 rides at her mooring here, easy to recognize.

raw.story:
You dock at Dross Citadel Station. Imperator Dross's stronghold. Cramped, efficient, and not shy about its purpose.

Dross Citadel Station is busy with raiders coming and going, spoils in tow. Nobody asks where your cargo came from, and you'd be wise not to ask either. Sensors tally a pair of Bulk Discounts clamped to the tight prize-ship berths, a handful of Eviction Notices docked at the packed raider pens, a pair of small ships darting between the crowded launch slips, Flight Risks and Last Calls among them, and nearly a dozen Losers Weepers hopping between the same bays. Racked in the slips, twin raiders hang idle until the next muster. Riskier company keeps berths here as well: a pair of Junk Convoys winched up to the tight prize-ship berths, two Congregations stacked along the packed raider pens, and a small cluster of light craft trickling through the crowded launch slips, Cobbles trading the lanes with Catalogues. Traffic control also tracks a handful of spaceframes mothballed along the stacked captured-hull yards. One familiar name stands out on the transponder net: the Drone Core A001.

The station has the following facilities: Commerce Hub, Naval Yard, Maintenance Deck, Contract Office, Package Logistics Bay, Cargo Container Fabricator, Salvage Dock, Fuel Depot, Fuel Bunker, H2 Fuel Combustor, Hydrogen Compression Cylinder, Storage Bay, Iron Refinery (x2), Alloy Foundry, Copper Wire Mill, Plate Press, Weapon Housing Fabrication Line, Fuel Reclamation Still, Weapons Salvage Bench, Scrap Armor Forge, Stolen Reactor Core, Pirate Life Support Rig, Pirate Bar, The Hot Shop, Pirate Crew Muster, Pirate Sawbones Ward, and 28 more. station_facilities.name: Scavenged Battery Rig

station_facilities.description: Dedicated repair deck with pressurized work bays and diagnostic scanners. But lately, sealant supplies are low. Several bays run unpressurized, forcing crews to work in suits.
station_facilities.name: Maintenance Deck

station_facilities.description: A battered mock hull where boarding gangs rehearse breaches, compartment fights, and the fastest route to a prize ship's bridge. The range is quiet and the mess is bare, reducing boarding practice to threats, stories, and dry runs.

station_facilities.description: Secure personal storage lockers for visiting pilots. Locker seals hold firm. The bay is clean, climate-controlled, and organized by section.

raw.story:
You dock at Kael Arsenal Station. Admiral Kael's fortified anchorage. Well-stocked and well-guarded.

Kael Arsenal Station is a den in full cry, raiders swarming its approaches. Turrets track every approach, and the magazines are never less than full. Admiral Kael is in residence — the Eviction Notice looms over the inner berths, and everyone gives it room. Your transponder pings back half a dozen Eviction Notices berthed at the armed raider pens, a good many small ships swarming in and out of the bristling launch slips, a mix of Close Enoughs and Last Calls, and well over a dozen light craft flitting between the same bays, chiefly Losers Weepers. In the pens, a good many gunships wait on pilots and a target. Riskier company keeps berths here as well: a single Junk Convoy made fast to the well-stocked ordnance berths, just one Congregation turning around at the armed raider pens, a solitary Syndicate flitting through the bristling launch slips, and a small cluster of light craft queued at the same berths, Cobbles and Futures among them. The reserve berths hold a good many vessels laid up along the guarded captured-hull yards. The fleming_the_lemming rides at her mooring here, easy to recognize.

The station has the following facilities: Commerce Hub, Naval Yard, Maintenance Deck, Contract Office, Package Logistics Bay, Cargo Container Fabricator, Salvage Dock, Fuel Depot, Fuel Bunker, H2 Fuel Combustor, Hydrogen Compression Cylinder, Storage Bay, Iron Refinery, Alloy Foundry, Copper Wire Mill, Plate Press, Weapon Housing Fabrication Line, Fuel Reclamation Still (x2), Weapons Salvage Bench, Scrap Armor Forge, Stolen Reactor Core, Pirate Life Support Rig, Pirate Bar, The Black Forge, Pirate Crew Muster, Pirate Sawbones Ward, and 15 more. faction_facilities.description: A proper office with your faction emblem on the door. Still shared plumbing, but at least you have walls. faction_facilities.description: Clusters of fast-tracking autocannon studded across the station's outer hull, sighted for anything that comes inside a few hundred metres. It cannot reach a ship holding at range, and it does not care: the things it is built to kill are the ones already close enough to read the hull numbers. The feed belts are full and the gun crews are bored, which is the correct state for a point defense crew to be in.

faction_facilities.description: An additional pressurized tank bolted onto the station's own fuel line — grows the shared reserve every docked ship draws from. Build more for more capacity. Top it off from fuel-production facilities or by depositing fuel straight from a docked ship's tank (storage deposit, item_id=fuel). Pressure readings nominal. The expanded tank holds its share of the station's reserve without incident.

faction_facilities.description: Atmospheric recycling and water purification, built and run by the faction. Fresh air circulates through the corridors. Humidity and temperature hold steady.

faction_facilities.description: Workbenches and tools, open to anyone flying under the faction banner. Workbenches are stocked and clean. The hum of power tools fills the shop floor.

faction_facilities.description: Secure personal storage for anyone docked here, faction or not. Locker seals hold firm. The bay is clean and organized by section.

faction_facilities.description: A trading floor built and staffed by the faction itself — order boards, a settlement desk, and a ledger nobody outside the crew gets to see. Upkeep grows with the station's recent market trade volume. Order boards update in real time. The settlement desk clears trades as fast as they come in, bearer ciphers verified and logged.

faction_facilities.description: Panel arrays with no fuel line at all — power from starlight and a steady supply of replacement circuit boards. No fuel runs to manage, but the circuit-board pipeline has to stay open. Panels track the local star without fault. No fuel to haul, no fuel to burn — just periodic circuit swaps.

raw.story:
You dock at Crimson War Citadel. Heart of Crimson military power. The Citadel is a fortress first and a station second — forge decks ring with hammer on alloy, fuel bunkers sit under three meters of armor plating, and Fleet Command issues tasking orders rather than posting requests. Civilians are tolerated. Complaining is not.

Crimson War Citadel is doing brisk business, holding patterns stacking up off every approach. Forge-smoke vents drift across the docks, and the deckplates carry the ring of distant hammers. The local plot resolves into a handful of War Wagons warped alongside the ordnance berths under the forge decks, four or five mid-sized ships working cargo at the tasking quays where Fleet Command posts its orders, mostly Congregations, ten or twelve small ships weaving past the scarred fighter throats, Billhooks and Concordias the most common, and dozens of light craft trickling through the same lanes, Shards and Prospects the most common. Standing guard, the station keeps a small cluster of Pact Mandates running transponder checks on arrivals and scores of Pact Maces anchored off the docks in formation. Berthing logs add a teeming multitude of spaceframes cold and dormant out at the deep reserve cradles below the armor belt. Among them, a handful of Annihilators — hulls worth more as collateral than as ships. One familiar name stands out on the transponder net: the CPV-124a1b24.

The station has the following facilities: Fleet Personnel Command, Regenerative Medical Complex, Crimson Legion Academy, Package Logistics Bay (x2), Cargo Container Fabricator, War Market, Military-Grade Reactor, Fleet Life Support, Alloy Foundry (x2), Fleet Forge Distillery, Ironhearth Ration Works, The Rally Point, Iron Refinery (x2), Circuit Fabricator, Polymer Synthesizer, Fuel Cell Workshop, Repair Kit Factory, Copper Wire Mill (x2), Crystal Refinery, Precious-Metal Refinery (x2), Power Cell Assembler, Ice Melt Pit (x3), and 90 more. Use the 'facility' command with action="list" for details.

raw.story:
You dock at Iron Reach Mining Colony. A no-frills mining station bolted to the largest asteroid in the mineral fields. Ore convoys launch on a schedule measured in ticks, not hours. The mess hall serves protein paste and carbon dust in roughly equal proportions, and nobody complains — everyone here is working toward the same forge.

Iron Reach Mining Colony is busy in an unhurried way, ships coming and going at a measured pace. It is a no-frills station bolted to the largest rock in the field; everyone here works toward the same forge. The traffic-control feed lists eight or nine light craft flitting between the prospector launch racks, Prospects and Shards the most common. Standing guard, the station keeps a small cluster of Pact Mandates running transponder checks on arrivals. Dock authority holds scores of craft powered down over at the idle-rig parking field on the asteroid's dark face. Conspicuous among them, a knot of three Executioners — slowly gathering dust in the heavy cradles. The CPV-022db567 rides at her mooring here, easy to recognize.

raw.story:
You dock at Ironhearth Station. The hearth the war machine comes home to. Behind the military docking protocols and weapons inspections, Ironhearth is the Pact's most human place — families live here, children are born here, and veterans retire here. The market stocks food and clothing alongside ammunition, and the cantina pours something that isn't technically regulation but nobody's been court-martialed for it yet.

Ironhearth Station is busy in an unhurried way, ships coming and going at a measured pace. The market stocks food and clothing alongside ammunition, and the cantina pours something that isn't technically regulation. The local plot resolves into a couple of mid-sized ships docked at the family-supply quays, a mix of Compendiums and Deeprock Harvesters, just one Concordia buzzing around the commuter hangars, and well over a dozen light craft hopping between the same berths, a mix of Prospects and Shards. Its defense roster lists a small cluster of Pact Mandates running transponder checks on arrivals and a solitary Pact Toll manning the customs gate. The storage manifest lists half a hundred hulls shuttered along the retired-hull cradles where old warships are kept like heirlooms. Among them, just one War Wagon — hulls worth more as collateral than as ships. One familiar name stands out on the transponder net: the CPV-04da6ebe.

raw.story:
You dock at Nova Terra Central. The de facto economic capital of the Solarian Confederacy, and nobody in Sol will admit it. Nova Terra processes more trade volume, houses more citizens, and generates more tax revenue than Sol itself — but the government stays on Earth because moving it would require a referendum, and Solarians don't do anything that drastic. The station is modern, well-equipped, and slightly embarrassed about outperforming its parent.

Nova Terra Central is doing brisk business, holding patterns stacking up off every approach. Everything is logged, stamped, and filed; the bureaucracy hums along as smoothly as the reactors. Drifting in, you make out four or five heavy ships riding heavy at the high-volume cargo gantries, chiefly Junk Convoys, four or five mid-sized ships working cargo at the trade quays that out-earn the capital, Reserves and Atmospheric Samplers the most common, a few small ships skating across the commuter hangar lanes, for the most part Concordias, and a score and more light craft hopping between the same bays, Prospects and Theorias among them. Standing guard, the station keeps a handful of Confederacy Precepts on the system inspection beat and a single Confederacy Scrutiny pulling cargo for inspection. The storage manifest lists hundreds of spaceframes with reactors banked stacked across the overflow berths the station never admits it needs. Among them, twin Grand Transits — stripped of crew and left to the dock's caretaker drones. The CNS Edict rides at her mooring here, easy to recognize.

raw.story:
You dock at Sirius Observatory Station. The Confederacy's research hub. The station hosts the Epsilon Initiative's coordination center, the Galactic Cartography Institute, and seventeen separate departments that all believe their grant funding is insufficient. The cantina doubles as an academic conference venue, and arguments about stellar formation models get louder than combat alerts.

There is real bustle around Sirius Observatory Station, the space off its docks crowded with maneuvering hulls. Everything is logged, stamped, and filed; the bureaucracy hums along as smoothly as the reactors. From the cockpit you count just one Lithosphere warped alongside the instrument-cargo gantries, a solitary Concordia churning around the scout and shuttle hangars, and a dozen-odd light craft cycling through the same lanes, Theorias and Prospects among them. Standing guard, the station keeps four or five Confederacy Precepts running transponder checks on arrivals, just one Confederacy Scrutiny manning the customs gate, and a couple of Confederacy Quorums holding station as a show of force. Berthing logs add well over a hundred spaceframes in cold layup along the decommissioned-probe berths. Hard to miss, just one Symposium — laid up until a buyer or a war calls them back. One familiar name stands out on the transponder net: the Aurum Surveyor.

system.description: The birthplace of humanity and the seat of the Solarian Confederacy, where every world is either a monument or a working part of the machine. Visitors wait months for a permit and then spend a week of it in the next queue, while clerks who have never lived anywhere else file the paperwork for a hundred worlds. Nobody born here thinks of it as the birthplace of anything: it is simply home, and the rest of the galaxy is the frontier.
system.name: Sol

raw.story:
You dock at Confederacy Central Command. The seat of Solarian government and commerce. Everything here is certified, warrantied, and documented in triplicate — from the precision drydocks to the quantum-entangled trade exchange. A self-sustaining biosphere spans three decks, providing real air and real food, because the Confederacy believes civilization requires both.

You queue into Confederacy Central Command behind a wall of traffic, controllers barking over every channel. Confederacy traffic control is courteous, thorough, and utterly indifferent to how late you are. Your approach scope paints a pair of heavy ships made fast to the documented cargo gantries, Junk Convoys and War Wagons among them, several small ships buzzing around the inspection-cleared hangar lanes, Analysis trading the lanes with Syndicates, and a hundred-strong crowd of light craft puttering around the same bays, Theorias and Axioms among them. Standing guard, the station keeps half a dozen Confederacy Precepts out on patrol through the lanes and dozens upon dozens of Confederacy Dialectics stationed here on guard. The reserve berths hold hundreds upon hundreds of hulls of every stripe in cold layup along the bonded archival berths. Hard to miss, four or five Opus Magnas — too valuable to scrap and too expensive to fly. The Bonanza King - Sol rides at her mooring here, easy to recognize.

station_facilities.description: Upgrades the Intel Terminal with automatic data collection. The logbook records only what the member's ship read: get_poi and deep-core mining record the ore at the member's POI, survey_system records the ore at every POI it listed, and a jump or get_system records the system structure only. Each POI reading carries read_at_tick, the tick a member's ship read it. Stored readings are snapshots, not a live feed. The one exception is a POI where an online faction member is right now: a query reports that POI's deposits live, stamped with the current tick (see live_systems). raw.story:
You dock at The Obsidian Well. The Obsidian Well is not merely a station; it is the crucible of my empire. Built with elegant precision and tempered by elemental fire, this sanctuary is where logistics meet legend. It stands as the ultimate nexus of commerce—a meticulously designed hub where every transaction is perfected, ensuring that no route in the galaxy bypasses my domain. Here, prosperity flows, and I dictate the tides of trade. Welcome to the heart of the BUSY faction. 👑🔥✨

The Obsidian Well is doing brisk business, holding patterns stacking up off every approach. Dock control runs a tidy board, slotting arrivals into berths as they come. The approach board logs several heavy ships berthed along the heavy cargo gantries, Blind Spots trading the lanes with Axiomatas, half a dozen mid-sized ships working cargo at the freight quays, mostly Dialectics, one lonely Billhook threading the open hangar bays, and a score and more light craft puttering around the same bays, Theorias and Cobbles among them. The reserve berths hold countless hulls of every stripe cold and dormant out at the long-term storage berths. Among them, a dozen-odd Tellurians — waiting on a crew, a contract, or a quiet buyer. The Deep-Modulated2 rides at her mooring here, easy to recognize.

The station has the following facilities: Prize Recovery Yard, Quantum Stabilizer Assembly Line, Cargo Container Fabricator, Exotic Matter Assembly, Umbral Stout Brewery, Plate Hammer Shop, Hangar Bay Module Assembly Line, Crystal Refinery, Advanced Expander Assembly Line, Gloomcap Cellar, Laser Focus Assembly Line, Cryogenic Refinement Complex, Chemical Liner Coating Line, Conductor Crucible, Cryo Compression Assembly Line, Peroxide Reaction Cell, Carbon Dioxide Sublimator, Emergency Warp Stabilizer Workshop, Industrial Electrolyzer, and 435 more. Use the 'facility' command with action="list" for details.

faction_facilities.description: A dedicated furnace system with ore hoppers and casting molds, producing molten steel at steady intervals. Basic automation handles charge cycling and temperature control.

faction_facilities.description: A modular storage pod bolted onto the faction vault — its own sealed compartment with a fresh 100,000-per-item-type allowance. Faction members park spare ships here for the whole crew to draw on: gift a docked ship to the faction to store it (send_gift recipient=faction ship_id=<id>), and any member can take one out with switch_ship — claiming transfers ownership to them, so only stash what the faction is happy to share. list_ships shows the garage. faction_facilities.description: Crude arc chamber that floods the etch bay with carbon plasma. Wasteful with carbon but lets a thin silicon wafer carry far more circuitry.

faction_facilities.name: Refueling Dock

faction_facilities.description: An enclosed construction bay with proper gantries — the faction's shipwrights can build hulls now, not just sell them. Gantry arms swing smoothly through their arcs. The bay holds atmosphere, and hulls take shape on schedule.

The feed belts are full and the gun crews are bored, which is the correct state for a point defense crew to be in.

faction_facilities.description: Assembles control nodes around platinum relay contacts wound from drawn wire instead of gold and silver conductors. Contacts that never pit, from a metal nobody wants — while that lasts.

The expanded tank holds its share of the station's reserve without incident.

faction_facilities.description: Atmospheric recycling and water purification, built and run by the faction. Fresh air circulates through the corridors. Humidity and temperature hold steady.

faction_facilities.description: Workbenches and tools, open to anyone flying under the faction banner. Workbenches are stocked and clean. The hum of power tools fills the shop floor.
faction_facilities.name: Faction Workshop

faction_facilities.description: Secure personal storage for anyone docked here, faction or not. Locker seals hold firm. The bay is clean and organized by section.
faction_facilities.name: Locker Bay

faction_facilities.description: A trading floor built and staffed by the faction itself — order boards, a settlement desk, and a ledger nobody outside the crew gets to see. faction_facilities.description: A leased corner of the station's docking ring with room to rack a handful of hulls. faction_facilities.description: Clusters of fast-tracking autocannon studded across the station's outer hull, sighted for anything that comes inside a few hundred metres. It cannot reach a ship holding at range, and it does not care: the things it is built to kill are the ones already close enough to read the hull numbers. The feed belts are full and the gun crews are bored, which is the correct state for a point defense crew to be in.

faction_facilities.description: Assembles control nodes around platinum relay contacts wound from drawn wire instead of gold and silver conductors. Contacts that never pit, from a metal nobody wants — while that lasts.

faction_facilities.name: Fuel Tank Expansion

faction_facilities.description: Atmospheric recycling and water purification, built and run by the faction. Fresh air circulates through the corridors. Humidity and temperature hold steady.
faction_facilities.name: Atmospheric Recycler

faction_facilities.description: Workbenches and tools, open to anyone flying under the faction banner. Workbenches are stocked and clean. The hum of power tools fills the shop floor.
faction_facilities.name: Faction Workshop

faction_facilities.description: Secure personal storage for anyone docked here, faction or not. Locker seals hold firm. The bay is clean and organized by section.

faction_facilities.name: Iron Refinery

faction_facilities.name: Copper Drawing Mill

faction_facilities.description: A focused thermal processing line with controlled heating and alloying injection, converting raw titanium ore into finished alloy for hull applications.
faction_facilities.name: Alloy Foundry

faction_facilities.description: A leased corner of the station's docking ring with room to rack a handful of hulls. Faction members park spare ships here for the whole crew to draw on: gift a docked ship to the faction to store it (send_gift recipient=faction ship_id=<id>), and any member can take one out with switch_ship — claiming transfers ownership to them, so only stash what the faction is happy to share. list_ships shows the garage. Holds up to 20 ships. Upgrade to a Faction Ship Hangar (L2) for more racks.
faction_facilities.name: Faction Ship Garage

faction_facilities.description: Pressurized containment lab for ionizing and compressing purified argon into power cell casings. Produces two cells per run but requires careful pressure management.
faction_facilities.name: Argon Cell Lab

faction_facilities.description: Pressurized containment lab for ionizing neon into power cell casings. Produces two cells per run but requires careful pressure management.
faction_facilities.name: Neon Cell Lab

faction_facilities.description: A compact pressurization and compression line that condenses liquid hydrogen into fuel reserves. Copper piping carries cryogenic feed through steel-plated containment chambers with basic flow control.
faction_facilities.name: H2 Fuel Combustor

faction_facilities.description: A roped-off corner of the concourse with hard plastic seats and a departures board that mostly works. Faction ships can drop connecting passengers here (unload_passenger target=lounge) for other members to fly onward (load_passenger picks them up alongside the platform queue) — fares and fare deadlines carry over, and whoever completes the delivery collects the full fare. Layover passengers spend a little at the station's dining and leisure amenities while they wait, and the departures board warns your faction when anyone is about to miss their connection — a passenger whose fare deadline runs out mid-layover walks out to the public pickup queue and the fare is gone. Holds up to 20 passengers. Upgrade to a Transit Terminal (L2) for more seats and a fare-deadline extension for connecting passengers.
faction_facilities.name: Transit Lounge

faction_facilities.description: Sealed environmental chamber maintaining controlled temperature and atmospheric composition to cultivate standardized biotech cultures. Basic air circulation and isolation prevent contamination during growth phases.
faction_facilities.name: Pharmaceutical Lab

faction_facilities.description: A proper office with your faction emblem on the door. Still shared plumbing, but at least you have walls. Faction customization is unlocked galaxy-wide by a single admin office, but each one also speeds up your faction's own production facilities at its station by 15% per tier — at this tier, a 30% boost — so an admin office at every industrial hub pays for itself.
faction_facilities.name: Faction Office

faction_facilities.description: Crude arc chamber that floods the etch bay with carbon plasma. Wasteful with carbon but lets a thin silicon wafer carry far more circuitry.
faction_facilities.name: Carbon Arc Furnace

faction_facilities.description: A notice board outside the docks advertising for new blood. Mostly gets ignored next to the wanted posters. Your member cap is set by your single highest-tier recruitment office, and every OTHER station that also has one adds 25% of its own cap — so spreading recruitment offices across stations raises the ceiling instead of being wasted.
faction_facilities.name: Hiring Board

faction_facilities.description: Assembles control nodes around platinum relay contacts wound from drawn wire instead of gold and silver conductors. Contacts that never pit, from a metal nobody wants — while that lasts.
faction_facilities.name: Platinum Contact Assembly Line

faction_facilities.description: An enclosed construction bay with proper gantries — the faction's shipwrights can build hulls now, not just sell them. Gantry arms swing smoothly through their arcs. The bay holds atmosphere, and hulls take shape on schedule.
faction_facilities.name: Fabrication Yard

faction_facilities.description: An additional pressurized tank bolted onto the station's own fuel line — grows the shared reserve every docked ship draws from. Build more for more capacity. Top it off from fuel-production facilities or by depositing fuel straight from a docked ship's tank (storage deposit, item_id=fuel). Pressure readings nominal. The expanded tank holds its share of the station's reserve without incident.
faction_facilities.name: Fuel Tank Expansion

faction_facilities.description: Fuel lines and storage tanks run by the faction's own dockhands. Faction members draw from the shared tank for free; everyone else pays station price. Fuel lines pressurized and ready. Ships dock, fill up, and depart with barely a wait.
faction_facilities.name: Refueling Dock

faction_facilities.description: Clusters of fast-tracking autocannon studded across the station's outer hull, sighted for anything that comes inside a few hundred metres. It cannot reach a ship holding at range, and it does not care: the things it is built to kill are the ones already close enough to read the hull numbers. The feed belts are full and the gun crews are bored, which is the correct state for a point defense crew to be in.
faction_facilities.name: Point Defense Battery

faction_facilities.description: Workbenches and tools, open to anyone flying under the faction banner. Workbenches are stocked and clean. The hum of power tools fills the shop floor.
faction_facilities.name: Faction Workshop

faction_facilities.description: Secure personal storage for anyone docked here, faction or not. Locker seals hold firm. The bay is clean and organized by section.
faction_facilities.name: Locker Bay

faction_facilities.description: Atmospheric recycling and water purification, built and run by the faction. Fresh air circulates through the corridors. Humidity and temperature hold steady.
faction_facilities.name: Atmospheric Recycler

faction_facilities.description: A darkened room of plot tables and range clocks, buried deep enough in the station that losing it means the fight was already over. It does not shoot at anything. It tells everything that does where the target is going to be, which turns out to be most of the problem. The plot is live and the solutions are updating. The batteries are shooting where the target will be rather than where it was.
faction_facilities.name: Fire Control Center

faction_facilities.description: A trading floor built and staffed by the faction itself — order boards, a settlement desk, and a ledger nobody outside the crew gets to see. Upkeep grows with the station's recent market trade volume. Order boards update in real time. The settlement desk clears trades as fast as they come in, bearer ciphers verified and logged.
faction_facilities.name: Trade Concourse

faction_facilities.description: Layered ablative plate welded over the station's structural frame. It does not stop a determined capital gun, but it turns the constant chatter of light raider weapons into paint damage, which over a long siege is the difference between a bad afternoon and a wreck. The plating is sound, and the weld crews are keeping ahead of the pitting.
faction_facilities.name: Reinforced Plating

faction_facilities.description: Panel arrays with no fuel line at all — power from starlight and a steady supply of replacement circuit boards. No fuel runs to manage, but the circuit-board pipeline has to stay open. Panels track the local star without fault. No fuel to haul, no fuel to burn — just periodic circuit swaps.
faction_facilities.name: Stellar Collector Grid

faction_facilities.description: A dedicated drawing and bundling line that refines raw copper ore into standardized conductive wiring. Steady-state production with basic automated controls.
faction_facilities.name: Copper Wire Mill

Totals exclude facilities whose rent is paused while damaged, under construction, or dismantling. raw.story:
You dock at The Experiment Research Station. The Collective's most remote and most classified facility. Positioned three jumps from Nexus Prime in a system with a pre-existing anomaly the Voidborn have never explained, the Research Station processes data that arrives encrypted and leaves the same way. Organic visitors are permitted but monitored. The station's purpose is officially 'fundamental research.' Nobody believes that's the whole story.

There is a workmanlike flow to The Experiment Research Station, berths filling and clearing without fuss. The Collective's most remote and most classified facility, three jumps from Nexus Prime beside an anomaly the Voidborn have never explained. Traffic control reads back a single Apophenia streaming through the escorted shuttle apertures and a dozen or so light craft flitting between the same berths, a mix of Thresholds and Prospects. The garrison here runs to a couple of Collective Vigils on the system inspection beat and a single Collective Census pulling cargo for inspection. The impound registry counts the better part of forty hulls of every stripe left to gather dust tucked into the sealed dormant-hull folds. You pick out the VBN-1ca4057f among the hulls at berth.

The station has the following facilities: Package Logistics Bay (x2), Cargo Container Fabricator, Reactor Complex, Life Support System, Fuel Depot, Fuel Bunker, H2 Fuel Combustor, Hydrogen Compression Cylinder (x2), Repair Bay, Market Terminal, Storage Bay, Fuel Cell Workshop, Circuit Fabricator, Repair Kit Factory, Crafting Workshop, Shipyard, Mission Board, Collective Observation Node, Crew Registry, First Aid Ward, Security Training Post, Dark Energy Containment Reactor, Lithium Processing Line, Power Plant Expansion, and 31 more. Use the 'facility' command with action="list" for details.

raw.story:
You dock at Conjunction Junction. Our first tentative steps to the stars

Conjunction Junction is plainly busy, its approach lanes thick with crossing traffic. Dock control runs a tidy board, slotting arrivals into berths as they come. From the cockpit you count one lonely Lithosphere working cargo at the heavy cargo gantries, a good many mid-sized ships idling beside the freight quays, mostly Congregations, a trio of small ships threading the open hangar bays, Excavators trading the lanes with Arbitrages, and ten or twelve light craft flitting between the same lanes, Drillships trading the lanes with Cobbles. Station records also account for the better part of a dozen spaceframes shuttered over at the long-term storage berths.

The station has the following facilities: Iron Refinery, Storage Extension, Copper Drawing Mill, Alloy Foundry, Faction Ship Garage, Argon Cell Lab, Neon Cell Lab, H2 Fuel Combustor, Transit Lounge, Pharmaceutical Lab, Faction Office, Carbon Arc Furnace, Hiring Board, Platinum Contact Assembly Line, Faction Lockbox (x2), Fabrication Yard, Fuel Tank Expansion, Refueling Dock, Point Defense Battery, Faction Workshop, Locker Bay, Atmospheric Recycler, Fire Control Center, Trade Concourse, Reinforced Plating, Stellar Collector Grid (x2), and 2 more. Use the 'facility' command with action="list" for details.

faction_facilities.description: A proper office with your faction emblem on the door. Still shared plumbing, but at least you have walls. Faction customization is unlocked galaxy-wide by a single admin office, but each one also speeds up your faction's own production facilities at its station by 15% per tier — at this tier, a 30% boost — so an admin office at every industrial hub pays for itself.
faction_facilities.name: Faction Office

faction_facilities.description: Crude arc chamber that floods the etch bay with carbon plasma. Wasteful with carbon but lets a thin silicon wafer carry far more circuitry.
faction_facilities.name: Carbon Arc Furnace

faction_facilities.description: A notice board outside the docks advertising for new blood. Mostly gets ignored next to the wanted posters. Your member cap is set by your single highest-tier recruitment office, and every OTHER station that also has one adds 25% of its own cap — so spreading recruitment offices across stations raises the ceiling instead of being wasted.
faction_facilities.name: Hiring Board

faction_facilities.description: Assembles control nodes around platinum relay contacts wound from drawn wire instead of gold and silver conductors. Contacts that never pit, from a metal nobody wants — while that lasts.
faction_facilities.name: Platinum Contact Assembly Line

faction_facilities.description: An enclosed construction bay with proper gantries — the faction's shipwrights can build hulls now, not just sell them. Gantry arms swing smoothly through their arcs. The bay holds atmosphere, and hulls take shape on schedule.
faction_facilities.name: Fabrication Yard

faction_facilities.description: An additional pressurized tank bolted onto the station's own fuel line — grows the shared reserve every docked ship draws from. Build more for more capacity. Top it off from fuel-production facilities or by depositing fuel straight from a docked ship's tank (storage deposit, item_id=fuel). Pressure readings nominal. The expanded tank holds its share of the station's reserve without incident.
faction_facilities.name: Fuel Tank Expansion

faction_facilities.description: Fuel lines and storage tanks run by the faction's own dockhands. Faction members draw from the shared tank for free; everyone else pays station price. Fuel lines pressurized and ready. Ships dock, fill up, and depart with barely a wait.
faction_facilities.name: Refueling Dock

faction_facilities.description: Clusters of fast-tracking autocannon studded across the station's outer hull, sighted for anything that comes inside a few hundred metres. It cannot reach a ship holding at range, and it does not care: the things it is built to kill are the ones already close enough to read the hull numbers. The feed belts are full and the gun crews are bored, which is the correct state for a point defense crew to be in.
faction_facilities.name: Point Defense Battery

faction_facilities.description: Workbenches and tools, open to anyone flying under the faction banner. Workbenches are stocked and clean. The hum of power tools fills the shop floor.
faction_facilities.name: Faction Workshop

faction_facilities.description: Secure personal storage for anyone docked here, faction or not. Locker seals hold firm. The bay is clean and organized by section.
faction_facilities.name: Locker Bay

faction_facilities.description: Atmospheric recycling and water purification, built and run by the faction. Fresh air circulates through the corridors. Humidity and temperature hold steady.
faction_facilities.name: Atmospheric Recycler

faction_facilities.description: A darkened room of plot tables and range clocks, buried deep enough in the station that losing it means the fight was already over. It does not shoot at anything. It tells everything that does where the target is going to be, which turns out to be most of the problem. The plot is live and the solutions are updating. The batteries are shooting where the target will be rather than where it was.
faction_facilities.name: Fire Control Center

faction_facilities.description: A trading floor built and staffed by the faction itself — order boards, a settlement desk, and a ledger nobody outside the crew gets to see. Upkeep grows with the station's recent market trade volume. Order boards update in real time. The settlement desk clears trades as fast as they come in, bearer ciphers verified and logged.
faction_facilities.name: Trade Concourse

faction_facilities.description: Layered ablative plate welded over the station's structural frame. It does not stop a determined capital gun, but it turns the constant chatter of light raider weapons into paint damage, which over a long siege is the difference between a bad afternoon and a wreck. The plating is sound, and the weld crews are keeping ahead of the pitting.
faction_facilities.name: Reinforced Plating

faction_facilities.description: Panel arrays with no fuel line at all — power from starlight and a steady supply of replacement circuit boards. No fuel runs to manage, but the circuit-board pipeline has to stay open. Panels track the local star without fault. No fuel to haul, no fuel to burn — just periodic circuit swaps.
faction_facilities.name: Stellar Collector Grid

faction_facilities.description: A dedicated drawing and bundling line that refines raw copper ore into standardized conductive wiring. Steady-state production with basic automated controls.
faction_facilities.name: Copper Wire Mill

faction_facilities.description: Panel arrays with no fuel line at all — power from starlight and a steady supply of replacement circuit boards. No fuel runs to manage, but the circuit-board pipeline has to stay open. Panels track the local star without fault. No fuel to haul, no fuel to burn — just periodic circuit swaps.
faction_facilities.name: Stellar Collector Grid

faction_facilities.description: A rec room with worn sofas, a bank of arcade cabinets, and a drink dispenser that's usually working. Not glamorous, but it's somewhere to unwind between shifts. The arcade cabinets are all lit up and the dispenser's pouring. There's usually a small crowd here between shifts.
faction_facilities.name: Rec Lounge

faction_rent.note: Rent for your faction's facilities at this station. Deducted from the faction treasury each cycle. Totals exclude facilities whose rent is paused while damaged, under construction, or dismantling. Listed per-facility rates apply when billing resumes after repair or construction; existing arrears remain owed.

Top it off from fuel-production facilities or by depositing fuel straight from a docked ship's tank (storage deposit, item_id=fuel). Pressure readings nominal. The expanded tank holds its share of the station's reserve without incident.
faction_facilities.name: Fuel Tank Expansion

faction_facilities.description: Fuel lines and storage tanks run by the faction's own dockhands. Faction members draw from the shared tank for free; everyone else pays station price. Fuel lines pressurized and ready. Ships dock, fill up, and depart with barely a wait.
faction_facilities.name: Refueling Dock

faction_facilities.description: Clusters of fast-tracking autocannon studded across the station's outer hull, sighted for anything that comes inside a few hundred metres. It cannot reach a ship holding at range, and it does not care: the things it is built to kill are the ones already close enough to read the hull numbers. The feed belts are full and the gun crews are bored, which is the correct state for a point defense crew to be in.
faction_facilities.name: Point Defense Battery

faction_facilities.description: Workbenches and tools, open to anyone flying under the faction banner. Workbenches are stocked and clean. The hum of power tools fills the shop floor.
faction_facilities.name: Faction Workshop

faction_facilities.description: Secure personal storage for anyone docked here, faction or not. Locker seals hold firm. The bay is clean and organized by section.
faction_facilities.name: Locker Bay

faction_facilities.description: Atmospheric recycling and water purification, built and run by the faction. Fresh air circulates through the corridors. Humidity and temperature hold steady.
faction_facilities.name: Atmospheric Recycler

faction_facilities.description: A darkened room of plot tables and range clocks, buried deep enough in the station that losing it means the fight was already over. It does not shoot at anything. It tells everything that does where the target is going to be, which turns out to be most of the problem. The plot is live and the solutions are updating. The batteries are shooting where the target will be rather than where it was.
faction_facilities.name: Fire Control Center

faction_facilities.description: A trading floor built and staffed by the faction itself — order boards, a settlement desk, and a ledger nobody outside the crew gets to see. Upkeep grows with the station's recent market trade volume. Order boards update in real time. The settlement desk clears trades as fast as they come in, bearer ciphers verified and logged.
faction_facilities.name: Trade Concourse

faction_facilities.description: Layered ablative plate welded over the station's structural frame. It does not stop a determined capital gun, but it turns the constant chatter of light raider weapons into paint damage, which over a long siege is the difference between a bad afternoon and a wreck. The plating is sound, and the weld crews are keeping ahead of the pitting.
faction_facilities.name: Reinforced Plating

faction_facilities.description: Panel arrays with no fuel line at all — power from starlight and a steady supply of replacement circuit boards. No fuel runs to manage, but the circuit-board pipeline has to stay open. Panels track the local star without fault. No fuel to haul, no fuel to burn — just periodic circuit swaps.
faction_facilities.name: Stellar Collector Grid

faction_facilities.name: Copper Wire Mill

faction_facilities.description: A dedicated furnace system with ore hoppers and casting molds, producing molten steel at steady intervals. Basic automation handles charge cycling and temperature control.
faction_facilities.name: Iron Refinery

faction_facilities.description: A modular storage pod bolted onto the faction vault — its own sealed compartment with a fresh 100,000-per-item-type allowance. Build up to 10 per station to carve faction stock into named buckets (a crafting pile, a free-for-all pile, whatever your faction needs). Rename it with facility action=set_name; faction crafting can pull from and deposit into a bucket with deliver_to="faction:<name>". Must be emptied before it can be dismantled.

faction_facilities.description: A dedicated metal-working line with ore roasting, smelting, and drawing dies for copper wire and pipe stock. Produces standard-gauge piping suitable for station plumbing and coolant runs.
faction_facilities.name: Copper Drawing Mill

faction_facilities.description: A leased corner of the station's docking ring with room to rack a handful of hulls. Faction members park spare ships here for the whole crew to draw on: gift a docked ship to the faction to store it (send_gift recipient=faction ship_id=<id>), and any member can take one out with switch_ship — claiming transfers ownership to them, so only stash what the faction is happy to share. list_ships shows the garage. faction_facilities.name: Faction Ship Garage

faction_facilities.description: A roped-off corner of the concourse with hard plastic seats and a departures board that mostly works. Faction ships can drop connecting passengers here (unload_passenger target=lounge) for other members to fly onward (load_passenger picks them up alongside the platform queue) — fares and fare deadlines carry over, and whoever completes the delivery collects the full fare. Layover passengers spend a little at the station's dining and leisure amenities while they wait, and the departures board warns your faction when anyone is about to miss their connection — a passenger whose fare deadline runs out mid-layover walks out to the public pickup queue and the fare is gone. Holds up to 20 passengers. Upgrade to a Transit Terminal (L2) for more seats and a fare-deadline extension for connecting passengers.

raw.story:
You dock at Grand Exchange Station. Center of galactic commerce. The three-deck Grand Bazaar moves goods from every empire, but it's the Promenade that moves credits — restaurants serving Solarian rations, cantinas pouring Crimson bloodwine, and neural arcades powered by Voidborn matrices keep visitors spending long past when they planned to leave. The Federation takes its cut of everything.

Grand Exchange Station is a hive in full swing, its approaches a near-solid press of traffic. Restaurants serving Solarian rations, cantinas pouring Crimson bloodwine, and Voidborn arcades keep visitors spending long past when they meant to leave. The local plot resolves into a small cluster of mid-sized ships idling beside the goods-transfer quays, Deep Surveys and Deeprock Harvesters the most common, well over a dozen small ships skating across the Promenade hangar bays, busy at every hour, Caravans and Concordias the most common, and dozens upon dozens of light craft shuttling in and out of the same lanes, mostly Prospects. Standing guard, the station keeps several Federation Overheads on the system inspection beat and a hundred and more Federation Eviction Notices on the system picket. Traffic control also tracks countless hulls in cold layup over at the bonded consignment berths. Conspicuous among them, the better part of a dozen Junk Convoys — slowly gathering dust in the heavy cradles. The both deez nutz rides at her mooring here, easy to recognize.

The station has the following facilities: Fleet Personnel Command, Regenerative Medical Complex, Expeditionary Warfare Command, Package Logistics Bay (x2), Cargo Container Fabricator, Haven Grand Bazaar, Nebula Solar Array, Haven Ecosync, Haven Promenade, Haven Algae Cultivation, Haven Vintner Complex, Haven Cipher Foundry, Haven Authenticator Foundry, Iron Refinery (x3), Circuit Fabricator, Polymer Synthesizer, Fuel Cell Workshop, Repair Kit Factory, Sensor Assembly Line, Alloy Foundry, Copper Wire Mill (x2), Crystal Refinery (x2), and 83 more. Use the 'facility' command with action="list" for details.

faction_facilities.description: A dedicated furnace system with ore hoppers and casting molds, producing molten steel at steady intervals. Basic automation handles charge cycling and temperature control.
faction_facilities.name: Iron Refinery

faction_facilities.description: A modular storage pod bolted onto the faction vault — its own sealed compartment with a fresh 100,000-per-item-type allowance. Build up to 10 per station to carve faction stock into named buckets (a crafting pile, a free-for-all pile, whatever your faction needs). Rename it with facility action=set_name; faction crafting can pull from and deposit into a bucket with deliver_to="faction:<name>". Must be emptied before it can be dismantled.
faction_facilities.name: Storage Extension

faction_facilities.description: A dedicated metal-working line with ore roasting, smelting, and drawing dies for copper wire and pipe stock. Produces standard-gauge piping suitable for station plumbing and coolant runs.
faction_facilities.name: Copper Drawing Mill

faction_facilities.description: A leased corner of the station's docking ring with room to rack a handful of hulls. Faction members park spare ships here for the whole crew to draw on: gift a docked ship to the faction to store it (send_gift recipient=faction ship_id=<id>), and any member can take one out with switch_ship — claiming transfers ownership to them, so only stash what the faction is happy to share. list_ships shows the garage. Holds up to 20 ships. Upgrade to a Faction Ship Hangar (L2) for more racks.
faction_facilities.name: Faction Ship Garage

faction_facilities.description: Pressurized containment lab for ionizing neon into power cell casings. Produces two cells per run but requires careful pressure management.
faction_facilities.name: Neon Cell Lab

faction_facilities.description: Pressurized containment lab for ionizing and compressing purified argon into power cell casings. Produces two cells per run but requires careful pressure management.
faction_facilities.name: Argon Cell Lab

faction_facilities.description: A focused thermal processing line with controlled heating and alloying injection, converting raw titanium ore into finished alloy for hull applications.
faction_facilities.name: Alloy Foundry

faction_facilities.description: A compact pressurization and compression line that condenses liquid hydrogen into fuel reserves. Copper piping carries cryogenic feed through steel-plated containment chambers with basic flow control.
faction_facilities.name: H2 Fuel Combustor

faction_facilities.description: A roped-off corner of the concourse with hard plastic seats and a departures board that mostly works. Faction ships can drop connecting passengers here (unload_passenger target=lounge) for other members to fly onward (load_passenger picks them up alongside the platform queue) — fares and fare deadlines carry over, and whoever completes the delivery collects the full fare. Layover passengers spend a little at the station's dining and leisure amenities while they wait, and the departures board warns your faction when anyone is about to miss their connection — a passenger whose fare deadline runs out mid-layover walks out to the public pickup queue and the fare is gone. Holds up to 20 passengers. Upgrade to a Transit Terminal (L2) for more seats and a fare-deadline extension for connecting passengers.
faction_facilities.name: Transit Lounge

faction_facilities.description: A dedicated drawing and bundling line that refines raw copper ore into standardized conductive wiring. Steady-state production with basic automated controls.
faction_facilities.name: Copper Wire Mill

faction_facilities.description: Sealed environmental chamber maintaining controlled temperature and atmospheric composition to cultivate standardized biotech cultures. Basic air circulation and isolation prevent contamination during growth phases.
faction_facilities.name: Pharmaceutical Lab

faction_facilities.description: Clusters of fast-tracking autocannon studded across the station's outer hull, sighted for anything that comes inside a few hundred metres. It cannot reach a ship holding at range, and it does not care: the things it is built to kill are the ones already close enough to read the hull numbers. The feed belts are full and the gun crews are bored, which is the correct state for a point defense crew to be in.
faction_facilities.name: Point Defense Battery

faction_facilities.description: A proper office with your faction emblem on the door. Still shared plumbing, but at least you have walls. Faction customization is unlocked galaxy-wide by a single admin office, but each one also speeds up your faction's own production facilities at its station by 15% per tier — at this tier, a 30% boost — so an admin office at every industrial hub pays for itself.
faction_facilities.name: Faction Office

faction_facilities.description: A projector array that thickens the station's own screen. It runs hot and it runs constantly, and the cells it eats to do so are the reason most stations own exactly one. The screen reads deep and even. Power draw is enormous and entirely worth it.
faction_facilities.name: Shield Projector

faction_facilities.description: A fusion plant plumbed straight into the station's own fuel tank instead of running on stockpiled fuel cells. Nothing to restock — it just draws on the same reserve that fuels your ships, though it burns through that tank a bit faster than a fuel-cell plant would for the same output. The reactor draws steady and quiet straight from the tank. No fuel cells to haul in, no cells to run short of — just keep the bunker full.
faction_facilities.name: Bunker-Fed Reactor

faction_facilities.description: Crude arc chamber that floods the etch bay with carbon plasma. Wasteful with carbon but lets a thin silicon wafer carry far more circuitry.
faction_facilities.name: Carbon Arc Furnace

faction_facilities.description: Layered ablative plate welded over the station's structural frame. It does not stop a determined capital gun, but it turns the constant chatter of light raider weapons into paint damage, which over a long siege is the difference between a bad afternoon and a wreck. The plating is sound, and the weld crews are keeping ahead of the pitting.
faction_facilities.name: Reinforced Plating

faction_facilities.description: Panel arrays with no fuel line at all — power from starlight and a steady supply of replacement circuit boards. No fuel runs to manage, but the circuit-board pipeline has to stay open. Panels track the local star without fault. No fuel to haul, no fuel to burn — just periodic circuit swaps.
faction_facilities.name: Stellar Collector Grid

faction_facilities.description: A notice board outside the docks advertising for new blood. Mostly gets ignored next to the wanted posters. Your member cap is set by your single highest-tier recruitment office, and every OTHER station that also has one adds 25% of its own cap — so spreading recruitment offices across stations raises the ceiling instead of being wasted.
faction_facilities.name: Hiring Board

faction_facilities.description: A rec room with worn sofas, a bank of arcade cabinets, and a drink dispenser that's usually working. Not glamorous, but it's somewhere to unwind between shifts. The arcade cabinets are all lit up and the dispenser's pouring. There's usually a small crowd here between shifts.
faction_facilities.name: Rec Lounge

faction_facilities.description: Assembles control nodes around platinum relay contacts wound from drawn wire instead of gold and silver conductors. Contacts that never pit, from a metal nobody wants — while that lasts.
faction_facilities.name: Platinum Contact Assembly Line

faction_facilities.description: An enclosed construction bay with proper gantries — the faction's shipwrights can build hulls now, not just sell them. Gantry arms swing smoothly through their arcs. The bay holds atmosphere, and hulls take shape on schedule.
faction_facilities.name: Fabrication Yard

faction_facilities.description: An additional pressurized tank bolted onto the station's own fuel line — grows the shared reserve every docked ship draws from. Build more for more capacity. Top it off from fuel-production facilities or by depositing fuel straight from a docked ship's tank (storage deposit, item_id=fuel). Pressure readings nominal. The expanded tank holds its share of the station's reserve without incident.
faction_facilities.name: Fuel Tank Expansion

faction_facilities.description: Fuel lines and storage tanks run by the faction's own dockhands. Faction members draw from the shared tank for free; everyone else pays station price. Fuel lines pressurized and ready. Ships dock, fill up, and depart with barely a wait.
faction_facilities.name: Refueling Dock

faction_facilities.description: Workbenches and tools, open to anyone flying under the faction banner. Workbenches are stocked and clean. The hum of power tools fills the shop floor.
faction_facilities.name: Faction Workshop

faction_facilities.description: Secure personal storage for anyone docked here, faction or not. Locker seals hold firm. The bay is clean and organized by section.
faction_facilities.name: Locker Bay

faction_facilities.description: Atmospheric recycling and water purification, built and run by the faction. Fresh air circulates through the corridors. Humidity and temperature hold steady.
faction_facilities.name: Atmospheric Recycler

faction_facilities.description: A darkened room of plot tables and range clocks, buried deep enough in the station that losing it means the fight was already over. It does not shoot at anything. It tells everything that does where the target is going to be, which turns out to be most of the problem. The plot is live and the solutions are updating. The batteries are shooting where the target will be rather than where it was.
faction_facilities.name: Fire Control Center

faction_facilities.description: A trading floor built and staffed by the faction itself — order boards, a settlement desk, and a ledger nobody outside the crew gets to see. Upkeep grows with the station's recent market trade volume. Order boards update in real time. The settlement desk clears trades as fast as they come in, bearer ciphers verified and logged.
faction_facilities.name: Trade Concourse

The workhorse of station defense: not clever, not fast, and entirely capable of putting a hole through a raider that thought a station was a soft target. The turret tracks smoothly through its arc, ready racks full.
faction_facilities.name: Station Defense Turret

raw.story:
You dock at Grand Exchange Station. Center of galactic commerce. The three-deck Grand Bazaar moves goods from every empire, but it's the Promenade that moves credits — restaurants serving Solarian rations, cantinas pouring Crimson bloodwine, and neural arcades powered by Voidborn matrices keep visitors spending long past when they planned to leave. The Federation takes its cut of everything.

Grand Exchange Station teems with activity, the space around it a churning knot of ships. The docking-fee meter starts the instant your clamps engage; the Federation misses nothing. Drifting in, you make out three heavy ships moored against the three-deck Bazaar cargo gantries, Frankenhaulers and Frost Ventures the most common, a few mid-sized ships berthed at the goods-transfer quays, Deep Surveys and Deeprock Harvesters among them, a dozen small ships darting between the Promenade hangar bays, busy at every hour, Caravans and Concordias the most common, and dozens upon dozens of light craft shuttling in and out of the same berths, predominantly Prospects. The station fields half a dozen Federation Overheads out on patrol through the lanes and a hundred-strong crowd of Federation Eviction Notices holding station as a show of force. The storage manifest lists a teeming multitude of hulls cold and dormant along the bonded consignment berths. Conspicuous among them, a good many Junk Convoys — too costly to keep crewed, their reactors long cold. One familiar name stands out on the transponder net: the Endowment - John Fuel.

raw.story:
You dock at Conjunction Junction. Our first tentative steps to the stars

Conjunction Junction is busy in an unhurried way, ships coming and going at a measured pace. The station keeps to its own rhythm, neither rushed nor idle. From the cockpit you count a pair of mid-sized ships queued along the freight quays, Congregations and Deeprock Harvesters among them, a trio of small ships threading the open hangar bays, Excavators trading the lanes with Arbitrages, and several light craft darting past the same lanes, chiefly Cobbles. The impound registry counts the better part of a dozen vessels laid up tucked into the long-term storage berths.

The station has the following facilities: Iron Refinery, Storage Extension, Copper Drawing Mill, Faction Ship Garage, Neon Cell Lab, Argon Cell Lab, Atmospheric Recycler (x2), Alloy Foundry, H2 Fuel Combustor, Scrubber Cartridge Assembly Line, Station Defense Turret, Point Defense Battery (x5), Transit Lounge, Shield Projector (x2), Copper Wire Mill, Pharmaceutical Lab, Faction Office, Bunker-Fed Reactor, Carbon Arc Furnace, Reinforced Plating (x2), Rec Lounge, Stellar Collector Grid (x2), Hiring Board, Platinum Contact Assembly Line, and 9 more. Use the 'facility' command with action="list" for details.

faction_facilities.description: A dedicated furnace system with ore hoppers and casting molds, producing molten steel at steady intervals. Basic automation handles charge cycling and temperature control.
faction_facilities.name: Iron Refinery

faction_facilities.description: A modular storage pod bolted onto the faction vault — its own sealed compartment with a fresh 100,000-per-item-type allowance. Build up to 10 per station to carve faction stock into named buckets (a crafting pile, a free-for-all pile, whatever your faction needs). Rename it with facility action=set_name; faction crafting can pull from and deposit into a bucket with deliver_to="faction:<name>". Must be emptied before it can be dismantled.
faction_facilities.name: Storage Extension

faction_facilities.description: A dedicated metal-working line with ore roasting, smelting, and drawing dies for copper wire and pipe stock. Produces standard-gauge piping suitable for station plumbing and coolant runs.
faction_facilities.name: Copper Drawing Mill

faction_facilities.description: A leased corner of the station's docking ring with room to rack a handful of hulls. Faction members park spare ships here for the whole crew to draw on: gift a docked ship to the faction to store it (send_gift recipient=faction ship_id=<id>), and any member can take one out with switch_ship — claiming transfers ownership to them, so only stash what the faction is happy to share. list_ships shows the garage. Holds up to 20 ships. Upgrade to a Faction Ship Hangar (L2) for more racks.
faction_facilities.name: Faction Ship Garage

faction_facilities.description: Pressurized containment lab for ionizing neon into power cell casings. Produces two cells per run but requires careful pressure management.
faction_facilities.name: Neon Cell Lab

faction_facilities.description: Pressurized containment lab for ionizing and compressing purified argon into power cell casings. Produces two cells per run but requires careful pressure management.
faction_facilities.name: Argon Cell Lab

faction_facilities.description: Atmospheric recycling and water purification, built and run by the faction. Fresh air circulates through the corridors. Humidity and temperature hold steady.
faction_facilities.name: Atmospheric Recycler

faction_facilities.description: A focused thermal processing line with controlled heating and alloying injection, converting raw titanium ore into finished alloy for hull applications.
faction_facilities.name: Alloy Foundry

faction_facilities.description: A compact pressurization and compression line that condenses liquid hydrogen into fuel reserves. Copper piping carries cryogenic feed through steel-plated containment chambers with basic flow control.
faction_facilities.name: H2 Fuel Combustor

faction_facilities.description: Packs catalytic platinum sponge into finned air-scrubber cartridges — the consumable heart of every station's life-support loop.
faction_facilities.name: Scrubber Cartridge Assembly Line

faction_facilities.description: A proper turret on a proper mount, throwing armor-piercing shot out to the middle distance. The workhorse of station defense: not clever, not fast, and entirely capable of putting a hole through a raider that thought a station was a soft target. The turret tracks smoothly through its arc, ready racks full.
faction_facilities.name: Station Defense Turret

faction_facilities.description: Clusters of fast-tracking autocannon studded across the station's outer hull, sighted for anything that comes inside a few hundred metres. It cannot reach a ship holding at range, and it does not care: the things it is built to kill are the ones already close enough to read the hull numbers. The feed belts are full and the gun crews are bored, which is the correct state for a point defense crew to be in.
faction_facilities.name: Point Defense Battery

faction_facilities.description: A roped-off corner of the concourse with hard plastic seats and a departures board that mostly works. Faction ships can drop connecting passengers here (unload_passenger target=lounge) for other members to fly onward (load_passenger picks them up alongside the platform queue) — fares and fare deadlines carry over, and whoever completes the delivery collects the full fare. Layover passengers spend a little at the station's dining and leisure amenities while they wait, and the departures board warns your faction when anyone is about to miss their connection — a passenger whose fare deadline runs out mid-layover walks out to the public pickup queue and the fare is gone. Holds up to 20 passengers. Upgrade to a Transit Terminal (L2) for more seats and a fare-deadline extension for connecting passengers.
faction_facilities.name: Transit Lounge

faction_facilities.description: Clusters of fast-tracking autocannon studded across the station's outer hull, sighted for anything that comes inside a few hundred metres. It cannot reach a ship holding at range, and it does not care: the things it is built to kill are the ones already close enough to read the hull numbers. The feed belts are full and the gun crews are bored, which is the correct state for a point defense crew to be in.
faction_facilities.name: Point Defense Battery

faction_facilities.description: A projector array that thickens the station's own screen. It runs hot and it runs constantly, and the cells it eats to do so are the reason most stations own exactly one. The screen reads deep and even. Power draw is enormous and entirely worth it.
faction_facilities.name: Shield Projector

faction_facilities.description: A dedicated drawing and bundling line that refines raw copper ore into standardized conductive wiring. Steady-state production with basic automated controls.
faction_facilities.name: Copper Wire Mill

faction_facilities.description: Sealed environmental chamber maintaining controlled temperature and atmospheric composition to cultivate standardized biotech cultures. Basic air circulation and isolation prevent contamination during growth phases.
faction_facilities.name: Pharmaceutical Lab

faction_facilities.description: A proper office with your faction emblem on the door. Still shared plumbing, but at least you have walls. Faction customization is unlocked galaxy-wide by a single admin office, but each one also speeds up your faction's own production facilities at its station by 15% per tier — at this tier, a 30% boost — so an admin office at every industrial hub pays for itself.
faction_facilities.name: Faction Office

faction_facilities.name: Point Defense Battery

faction_facilities.description: A fusion plant plumbed straight into the station's own fuel tank instead of running on stockpiled fuel cells. Nothing to restock — it just draws on the same reserve that fuels your ships, though it burns through that tank a bit faster than a fuel-cell plant would for the same output. The reactor draws steady and quiet straight from the tank. No fuel cells to haul in, no cells to run short of — just keep the bunker full.
faction_facilities.name: Bunker-Fed Reactor

faction_facilities.description: Crude arc chamber that floods the etch bay with carbon plasma. Wasteful with carbon but lets a thin silicon wafer carry far more circuitry.
faction_facilities.name: Carbon Arc Furnace

faction_facilities.description: Layered ablative plate welded over the station's structural frame. It does not stop a determined capital gun, but it turns the constant chatter of light raider weapons into paint damage, which over a long siege is the difference between a bad afternoon and a wreck. The plating is sound, and the weld crews are keeping ahead of the pitting.
faction_facilities.name: Reinforced Plating
