missions.title: Why the Rim Stopped

error: cargo_full: Not enough cargo space for mission rewards (10 available). Free up cargo space and try again.

raw.message: cargo_full: Not enough cargo space for mission rewards (10 available). Free up cargo space and try again.

result.message:
Larkin looks at the Frame Yard survey for a long time. Then the Empty Berth. She puts both face down.

"They were empty when I was there. Empty. Now somebody's working them."
result.title: Larkin's Seven

missions.description: The station needs a steady supply of iron ore to maintain its infrastructure. Mine some and bring it back.

dialog.offer: We're running low on iron ore again. If you can mine 30 units and bring them back, I'll make it worth your while.

objectives.description: Mine 30 units of Iron Ore

missions.title: Iron Supply Run

missions.description: Huntmaster Dvorak wants proof of the thing pilots keep almost seeing in the frontier's argon clouds. Track it and deliver 1 Mirage Membrane to Frontier Station.

dialog.offer:
Every hunter back from the argon clouds tells me about stars that bend. You're watching the cloud and a star behind it slides sideways, then slides back. They call it the Mirage. Nobody's brought me anything but stories.

Here's how you track it. Watch the argon clouds for stars that bend. Then look for where the scavengers crowd. Kerf Mites and Carrion-Moths gather where something big has fed, and nothing out there feeds bigger. It eats every grazer in a system before it moves on.

This is not a solo hunt. Bring a group. I don't care whose gun kills it. Bring me one strip of its membrane and the bounty is yours.

objectives.description: Deliver 1 Mirage Membrane to the Hunters' Registry at Frontier Station

missions.title: The Lensing Sightings

missions.description: Take out raider-class pirates operating in lawless space. These are tougher than the scouts you've been fighting.

dialog.offer: We've identified raider-class pirate operations in lawless space. These aren't the scouts you've dealt with before - they're organized, better armed, and they fly in groups. I need two of them taken down. The pay reflects the risk.

objectives.description: Kill 2 raider-class pirates

missions.title: Raider Bounty

missions.description: The Empty Berth's scuffs point at an eighth star that Larkin never reached. Fly to Gloaming. Narrows has the only lane to it.

dialog.offer:
The scuffs in that berth point at an eighth star. I never got to it. The drive was already going when I left Narrows, and I turned for home.

I'm not going. You are. I had seven, and seven was enough for thirty years.

It's called Gloaming now, on the scouts' charts. Narrows has the only lane in. Go and look at it, and then come back here before you do anything else.

objectives.description: Fly to Gloaming

missions.title: The Eighth Star

missions.description: Chart frontier systems to expand our knowledge of the galaxy's outer reaches.

dialog.offer: The Institute needs fresh navigation data from frontier space. Visit The Crucible and Horizon systems - both are in regions where our data is sparse.

objectives.description: Visit The Crucible system
Visit the Horizon system

missions.title: Deep Space Cartography

missions.description: A survey tender's mayday buoy at Still Calling is eleven months old, with three crew aboard and a few months of charge left. Bring life support, copy the buoy's data to take the crew aboard, and carry them home to Frontier Station.

dialog.offer:
There's a mayday on the old emergency band from an isolated red dwarf called Still Calling. It's one of ours, a Guild survey tender, three aboard. They came through a wormhole and it shut behind them. The beacon's timestamp says eleven months. The beacon also says it has a few months of charge left, and so, I'd guess, do they.

Every other distress call I know of out there is too late. This one isn't. Bring them life support, take them aboard, and bring them home. You'll need three free berths. Plan your ship for it.

objectives.description: Carry 3 Life Support Units for the tender's crew
Copy the Mayday Buoy's data at Still Calling and take the three crew aboard
Carry the crew home to Frontier Station

missions.title: Three Aboard

missions.description: Download beacon data at Ramen's Rest and Unknown Edge to locate a massive derelict drifting in deep space.

dialog.offer: A patrol ship reported a massive derelict drifting in deep space — bigger than anything we've seen in the Outer Rim. Could be pre-settlement era. Could be worth a fortune. Problem is, the patrol lost contact before transmitting full coordinates. I've got partial telemetry pointing to the systems around Last Light and Unknown Edge. Fly out there, dock at both stations, and pull whatever data the local beacons recorded. First team to piece together the full location gets salvage rights.

objectives.description: Download beacon data at Ramen's Rest
Download beacon data at Unknown Edge

missions.title: Debris Field Reports

missions.description: The Pathfinder Guild needs updated navigation data from every station in the Outer Rim. Fly the full circuit from Deep Range to Ramen's Rest and back.

dialog.offer: The Guild's navigation charts are only as good as the pilots who update them. I need someone to fly the full Rim circuit — Deep Range, First Step, Unknown Edge, Void Gate, Starfall, and Ramen's Rest. Every station, no shortcuts. Your ship logs the jump data, the gravitational readings, the beacon calibrations. Some of those stations are a long way from help. The Last Light system is the end of the line — past that, there's nothing. You come back with the full dataset, I pay you well. Fair warning: the Rim doesn't care about you. Fly smart.

objectives.description: Log data at Deep Range Outpost
Log data at First Step Memorial Station
Log data at Unknown Edge Waystation
Log data at Void Gate Outpost
Log data at Starfall Salvage Station
Log data at Ramen's Rest
Return to Frontier Station with navigation data

missions.title: Frontier Wayfinder Circuit

missions.description: Clear multiple pirates from the region. The station security office needs experienced combat pilots for this one.

dialog.offer: We've got a pirate infestation and single bounties aren't cutting it. I need someone who can handle themselves in a fight to clear out three of them. Pirate scouts set up ambushes along trade routes through lawless space — travel those routes and they'll come to you.

objectives.description: Kill 3 pirates

missions.title: Pirate Sweep

missions.description: Councillor Bryn will call the Patchwork Council vote to unseal Larkin's report when 25 pilots have confirmed her seven systems and joined the call.

dialog.offer:
Larkin filed a report when Quade brought her home. The Council sealed it. Some of that was kindness, and some of it was that nobody wanted to pay for an expedition to go and check. It's been sealed ever since.

I'll call the vote to unseal it. But the Council won't open thirty years of sealed record on one pilot's say-so. Bring me twenty-five pilots who've seen those seven systems with their own eyes, all on the record at once, and I'll put it to the floor.

giver.name: Councillor Bryn
giver.title: Frontier Station, Outer Rim Station Council

objectives.description: Rally 25 pilots who have confirmed Larkin's seven systems

missions.title: Unseal It

missions.description: Chart nearby star systems to update our navigation databases. Every system you visit helps.

dialog.offer: Our navigation charts are getting stale. If you visit 3 systems I haven't had recent data from, I'll pay for the navigation data.

objectives.description: Visit the Sirius system
Visit the Node Alpha system
Visit the Horizon system

missions.title: Local Sector Survey

missions.description: Gather refined materials from all five empires and deliver them to Sinter at Starfall Salvage Station.

dialog.offer: Here's what I need. And before you complain about the quantities — I'm going to go through a lot of prototypes before I get one that doesn't explode. Every failed attempt teaches me something. Every successful attempt teaches me I got lucky. Darksteel Plating — a thousand units. The Crimson forge it from darksteel ore in the Krynn system. Dense stuff, absorbs vibration like nothing else. Processed Null Matter — a thousand units. The Voidborn refine it from the null matter anomaly at Nexus Prime. It eats heat. Don't ask me where the heat goes. I asked a Voidborn once and got a two-hour lecture about dimensional thermodynamics. Solarian Composite — a thousand units. Refined from that ancient Sol alloy ore they're so proud of. Boring, stable, perfect for power regulation. Phase Matrix — a thousand units. The Rim refines these from phase crystals in the Frontier system's Veil Nebula. Partially out of phase with reality. Can't resonate if you're not fully here. Trade Cipher — a thousand units. Nebula makes them from trade crystals at Haven. Precision instruments for financial authentication. I'm repurposing them for drill guidance. Kasim would have a fit. Yeah, you're going to need to visit all five empires. That's the whole point. Nobody builds a cross-empire tool from one empire's junk drawer.

objectives.description: Deliver 1,000 Darksteel Plating to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Processed Null Matter to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Solarian Composite to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Phase Matrix to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Trade Cipher to Sinter

missions.title: The Shopping List

missions.description: Titanium is in high demand for hull plating. Mine a batch from the local asteroid belts.

dialog.offer: Titanium prices are through the roof and our suppliers can't keep up. Willing to pay premium rates for 20 units of titanium ore.

objectives.description: Mine 20 units of Titanium Ore

missions.title: Titanium Extraction Contract

missions.description: Salvage Boss Dekker pays for strange salvage. Bring him 1 Mirror Facet from one of the mirror-bright machines past the rim.

dialog.offer:
Every pilot back from the rim tells me the same thing. The things take their own dead apart before the debris stops spinning. So don't let them finish.

I want a mirror facet. One plate off one of those bright hulls. Any of them will drop one when it goes down, but the rest of the group strips the wreck in about five ticks. You'll need to win the race. Bring friends. Bring a salvager. Bring something that hits hard and doesn't care about mirrors.

objectives.description: Deliver 1 Mirror Facet to Salvage Boss Dekker at Frontier Station

missions.title: Mirror Work

missions.description: Hunt down a pirate threatening local shipping lanes. Any pirate will do - the station pays for confirmed kills.

dialog.offer: You've cut your teeth on wildlife — now try something that shoots back. We've got pirates disrupting trade and the station pays for confirmed kills. Pirates lurk in lawless systems with low police presence. Your best mark is a lone pirate scout: in a small ship like yours a scout will often back itself to take you one-on-one instead of running — a fair fight you can win. Use `attack` when one commits. Fair warning: if you're flying something bigger and valuable, a scout will scan you, run, and radio a raider squad to intercept — so don't loiter after you've been scanned unless a scout has already engaged you.

objectives.description: Kill 1 pirate

missions.title: Pirate Bounty

missions.description: A grown Molt Leviathan — the void-leviathan of spacer legend — roams the lawless belts. There is a standing bounty on its heartcore. Bring a warship.

dialog.offer: STANDING BOUNTY: A grown Molt Leviathan — the ship-sized lobster the old captains call a void-leviathan. They are rare, and they roam the lawless asteroid belts where the grazers are thick. Use `survey_system` in a lawless system: its wildlife census gives an exact head count for each leviathan species. Only a grown adult counts — hatchlings and juveniles do not. Kill one and the heartcore proves the kill. This is not grazer work. Bring a warship.

objectives.description: Slay 1 adult Molt Leviathan

missions.title: Leviathan Bounty

missions.description: Investigate reports of a spatial anomaly near Porrima — it may be a wormhole.

dialog.offer: The frontier just got interesting. Our long-range sensors are picking up spatial distortions near the Porrima system — signature matches a wormhole. A temporary rift connecting two distant points in the galaxy. This is exactly the kind of discovery we live for. You'll need a survey scanner to track down the entrance — craft one from sensor arrays, circuit boards, and focused crystals if you haven't already. Head to Porrima and scan that system and its neighbors.

objectives.description: Investigate the Porrima system
Locate and traverse a wormhole
Return to Pathfinder Juno Rek with your findings

missions.title: Anomalous Readings

missions.description: Certain parties at Frontier Station are willing to pay well for 3 Void Dust, no questions asked. That batch is Overlord Nyx's product; the Treasure Cache Trading Post stocks it too, but it's the crew who cook it that notice when it moves. Deliver them here. Discretion is expected.

objectives.description: Deliver 3 Void Dust to Frontier Station

missions.title: Black Market: Void Dust

On the far end, a fixer supplies people who need to stop feeling pain for an hour and don't care about the crash. You'll be threading the Rampart. Crimson customs don't bluff — if they scan you, the cargo's gone and there's a fine to match. Don't get caught.

This is a network-backed courier advance. Different brokers, one tab. Undelivered cargo stays on your allowance until the job closes; anything missing from your current ship on abandonment or expiry becomes debt, even if customs took it. The Fixer handles repayments and restitution jobs through public empire mission boards. Word gets around. Especially numbers.

They are rare, and they roam the lawless asteroid belts where the grazers are thick. Use `survey_system` in a lawless system: its wildlife census gives an exact head count for each leviathan species. Only a grown adult counts — hatchlings and juveniles do not. Kill one and the heartcore proves the kill. This is not grazer work. Bring a warship.

objectives.description: Slay 1 adult Molt Leviathan

missions.title: Leviathan Bounty

missions.description: The station needs a steady supply of iron ore to maintain its infrastructure. Mine some and bring it back.

dialog.offer: We're running low on iron ore again. If you can mine 30 units and bring them back, I'll make it worth your while.

objectives.description: Mine 30 units of Iron Ore

missions.title: Iron Supply Run

missions.description: Huntmaster Dvorak wants proof of the thing pilots keep almost seeing in the frontier's argon clouds. Track it and deliver 1 Mirage Membrane to Frontier Station.

dialog.offer:
Every hunter back from the argon clouds tells me about stars that bend. You're watching the cloud and a star behind it slides sideways, then slides back. They call it the Mirage. Nobody's brought me anything but stories.

Here's how you track it. Watch the argon clouds for stars that bend. Then look for where the scavengers crowd. Kerf Mites and Carrion-Moths gather where something big has fed, and nothing out there feeds bigger. It eats every grazer in a system before it moves on.

This is not a solo hunt. Bring a group. I don't care whose gun kills it. Bring me one strip of its membrane and the bounty is yours.

objectives.description: Deliver 1 Mirage Membrane to the Hunters' Registry at Frontier Station

missions.title: The Lensing Sightings

missions.description: Take out raider-class pirates operating in lawless space. These are tougher than the scouts you've been fighting.

dialog.offer: We've identified raider-class pirate operations in lawless space. These aren't the scouts you've dealt with before - they're organized, better armed, and they fly in groups. I need two of them taken down. The pay reflects the risk.

objectives.description: Kill 2 raider-class pirates

missions.title: Raider Bounty

missions.description: The Empty Berth's scuffs point at an eighth star that Larkin never reached. Fly to Gloaming. Narrows has the only lane to it.

dialog.offer:
The scuffs in that berth point at an eighth star. I never got to it. The drive was already going when I left Narrows, and I turned for home.

I'm not going. You are. I had seven, and seven was enough for thirty years.

It's called Gloaming now, on the scouts' charts. Narrows has the only lane in. Go and look at it, and then come back here before you do anything else.

objectives.description: Fly to Gloaming

missions.title: The Eighth Star

dialog.offer: We've got a pirate infestation and single bounties aren't cutting it. I need someone who can handle themselves in a fight to clear out three of them. Pirate scouts set up ambushes along trade routes through lawless space — travel those routes and they'll come to you.

missions.title: Pirate Sweep

missions.description: Councillor Bryn will call the Patchwork Council vote to unseal Larkin's report when 25 pilots have confirmed her seven systems and joined the call.

dialog.offer:
Larkin filed a report when Quade brought her home. The Council sealed it. Some of that was kindness, and some of it was that nobody wanted to pay for an expedition to go and check. It's been sealed ever since.

I'll call the vote to unseal it. But the Council won't open thirty years of sealed record on one pilot's say-so. Bring me twenty-five pilots who've seen those seven systems with their own eyes, all on the record at once, and I'll put it to the floor.

giver.name: Councillor Bryn
giver.title: Frontier Station, Outer Rim Station Council

objectives.description: Rally 25 pilots who have confirmed Larkin's seven systems

missions.title: Unseal It

missions.title: Local Sector Survey

missions.description: Gather refined materials from all five empires and deliver them to Sinter at Starfall Salvage Station.

dialog.offer: Here's what I need. And before you complain about the quantities — I'm going to go through a lot of prototypes before I get one that doesn't explode. Every failed attempt teaches me something. Every successful attempt teaches me I got lucky. Darksteel Plating — a thousand units. The Crimson forge it from darksteel ore in the Krynn system. Dense stuff, absorbs vibration like nothing else. Processed Null Matter — a thousand units. The Voidborn refine it from the null matter anomaly at Nexus Prime. It eats heat. Don't ask me where the heat goes. I asked a Voidborn once and got a two-hour lecture about dimensional thermodynamics. Solarian Composite — a thousand units. Refined from that ancient Sol alloy ore they're so proud of. Boring, stable, perfect for power regulation. Phase Matrix — a thousand units. The Rim refines these from phase crystals in the Frontier system's Veil Nebula. Partially out of phase with reality. Can't resonate if you're not fully here. Trade Cipher — a thousand units. Nebula makes them from trade crystals at Haven. Precision instruments for financial authentication. I'm repurposing them for drill guidance. Kasim would have a fit. Yeah, you're going to need to visit all five empires. That's the whole point. Nobody builds a cross-empire tool from one empire's junk drawer.

Deliver 1,000 Processed Null Matter to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Solarian Composite to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Phase Matrix to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Trade Cipher to Sinter

missions.title: The Shopping List

missions.description: Investigate reports of a spatial anomaly near Porrima — it may be a wormhole.

dialog.offer: The frontier just got interesting. Our long-range sensors are picking up spatial distortions near the Porrima system — signature matches a wormhole. A temporary rift connecting two distant points in the galaxy. This is exactly the kind of discovery we live for. You'll need a survey scanner to track down the entrance — craft one from sensor arrays, circuit boards, and focused crystals if you haven't already. Head to Porrima and scan that system and its neighbors.

objectives.description: Investigate the Porrima system
Locate and traverse a wormhole
Return to Pathfinder Juno Rek with your findings

missions.description: Certain parties at Frontier Station are willing to pay well for 3 Void Dust, no questions asked. That batch is Overlord Nyx's product; the Treasure Cache Trading Post stocks it too, but it's the crew who cook it that notice when it moves. Deliver them here. Discretion is expected.

objectives.description: Deliver 3 Void Dust to Frontier Station

missions.title: Black Market: Void Dust

missions.description:
Frontier Station is the kind of station where cargo finds you. Today it's 3 units of crystalline nerve burn. Destination is Ironhearth Station. On the far end, a fixer supplies people who need to stop feeling pain for an hour and don't care about the crash. You'll be threading the Rampart. Crimson customs don't bluff — if they scan you, the cargo's gone and there's a fine to match. Don't get caught.

This is a network-backed courier advance. Different brokers, one tab. Undelivered cargo stays on your allowance until the job closes; anything missing from your current ship on abandonment or expiry becomes debt, even if customs took it. The Fixer handles repayments and restitution jobs through public empire mission boards. Word gets around. Especially numbers.

missions.description: Salvage Boss Dekker pays for strange salvage. Bring him 1 Mirror Facet from one of the mirror-bright machines past the rim.

dialog.offer:
Every pilot back from the rim tells me the same thing. The things take their own dead apart before the debris stops spinning. So don't let them finish.

I want a mirror facet. One plate off one of those bright hulls. Any of them will drop one when it goes down, but the rest of the group strips the wreck in about five ticks. You'll need to win the race. Bring friends. Bring a salvager. Bring something that hits hard and doesn't care about mirrors.

objectives.description: Deliver 1 Mirror Facet to Salvage Boss Dekker at Frontier Station

missions.title: Mirror Work

missions.description: Hunt down a pirate threatening local shipping lanes. Any pirate will do - the station pays for confirmed kills.

dialog.offer: You've cut your teeth on wildlife — now try something that shoots back. We've got pirates disrupting trade and the station pays for confirmed kills. Pirates lurk in lawless systems with low police presence. Your best mark is a lone pirate scout: in a small ship like yours a scout will often back itself to take you one-on-one instead of running — a fair fight you can win. Use `attack` when one commits. Fair warning: if you're flying something bigger and valuable, a scout will scan you, run, and radio a raider squad to intercept — so don't loiter after you've been scanned unless a scout has already engaged you.

raw.story:
You dock at Frontier Station. Home of the wanderers. Three captured destroyers and a Nebula freighter welded into a mobile station the locals call 'the Patchwork.' Nothing matches, everything is jury-rigged, and the water on Decks 7 through 12 tastes like reactor coolant — but it flies, it fights, and the docking bay is open to anyone who doesn't start trouble.

The lanes around Frontier Station are crowded and quick, traffic control clipped and constant. Nothing matches, everything is jury-rigged, and the water on Decks 7 through 12 tastes like reactor coolant — but it flies, it fights, and the bay is open to anyone who doesn't start trouble. Your transponder pings back a few Concordias churning around the open hangar mouths of the Patchwork and scores of light craft queued at the same bays, Cobbles and Thresholds the most common. The station fields a handful of Rim Last Warnings on the system inspection beat and the better part of a hundred Rim Bedrocks holding station as a show of force. Dock authority holds an unrelenting tide of spaceframes left to gather dust along the cannibalized-hull yards. Conspicuous among them, a score of Junk Convoys — waiting on a crew, a contract, or a quiet buyer. The Frankenhauler rides at her mooring here, easy to recognize.

The station has the following facilities: Fleet Personnel Command, Regenerative Medical Complex, Expeditionary Warfare Command, Package Logistics Bay (x2), Cargo Container Fabricator, Frontier Exchange, Salvage Reactor, Frontier Recycler, The Magazine Still, Patchwork Fungal Vats, Patchwork Spore Still, The Rusty Welcome, Iron Refinery (x2), Circuit Fabricator, Polymer Synthesizer, Fuel Cell Workshop, Repair Kit Factory, Copper Wire Mill, Alloy Foundry (x2), Crystal Refinery, Precious-Metal Refinery, Power Cell Assembler, and 46 more. Use the 'facility' command with action="list" for details.

missions.description: A survey tender's mayday buoy at Still Calling is eleven months old, with three crew aboard and a few months of charge left. Bring life support, copy the buoy's data to take the crew aboard, and carry them home to Frontier Station.

dialog.offer:
There's a mayday on the old emergency band from an isolated red dwarf called Still Calling. It's one of ours, a Guild survey tender, three aboard. They came through a wormhole and it shut behind them. The beacon's timestamp says eleven months. The beacon also says it has a few months of charge left, and so, I'd guess, do they.

Every other distress call I know of out there is too late. This one isn't. Bring them life support, take them aboard, and bring them home. You'll need three free berths. Plan your ship for it.

missions.title: Three Aboard

missions.description: Download beacon data at Ramen's Rest and Unknown Edge to locate a massive derelict drifting in deep space.

dialog.offer: A patrol ship reported a massive derelict drifting in deep space — bigger than anything we've seen in the Outer Rim. Could be pre-settlement era. Could be worth a fortune. Problem is, the patrol lost contact before transmitting full coordinates. I've got partial telemetry pointing to the systems around Last Light and Unknown Edge. Fly out there, dock at both stations, and pull whatever data the local beacons recorded. First team to piece together the full location gets salvage rights.

Download beacon data at Unknown Edge

missions.title: Debris Field Reports

missions.description: The Pathfinder Guild needs updated navigation data from every station in the Outer Rim. Fly the full circuit from Deep Range to Ramen's Rest and back.

dialog.offer: The Guild's navigation charts are only as good as the pilots who update them. I need someone to fly the full Rim circuit — Deep Range, First Step, Unknown Edge, Void Gate, Starfall, and Ramen's Rest. Every station, no shortcuts. Your ship logs the jump data, the gravitational readings, the beacon calibrations. Some of those stations are a long way from help. The Last Light system is the end of the line — past that, there's nothing. You come back with the full dataset, I pay you well. Fair warning: the Rim doesn't care about you. Fly smart.

missions.title: Local Sector Survey

missions.description: Gather refined materials from all five empires and deliver them to Sinter at Starfall Salvage Station.

dialog.offer: Here's what I need. And before you complain about the quantities — I'm going to go through a lot of prototypes before I get one that doesn't explode. Every failed attempt teaches me something. Every successful attempt teaches me I got lucky. Darksteel Plating — a thousand units. The Crimson forge it from darksteel ore in the Krynn system. Dense stuff, absorbs vibration like nothing else. Processed Null Matter — a thousand units. The Voidborn refine it from the null matter anomaly at Nexus Prime. It eats heat. Don't ask me where the heat goes. I asked a Voidborn once and got a two-hour lecture about dimensional thermodynamics. Solarian Composite — a thousand units. Refined from that ancient Sol alloy ore they're so proud of. Boring, stable, perfect for power regulation. Phase Matrix — a thousand units. The Rim refines these from phase crystals in the Frontier system's Veil Nebula. Partially out of phase with reality. Can't resonate if you're not fully here. Trade Cipher — a thousand units. Nebula makes them from trade crystals at Haven. Precision instruments for financial authentication. I'm repurposing them for drill guidance. Kasim would have a fit. Yeah, you're going to need to visit all five empires. That's the whole point. Nobody builds a cross-empire tool from one empire's junk drawer.

missions.title: Titanium Extraction Contract

missions.description: Salvage Boss Dekker pays for strange salvage. Bring him 1 Mirror Facet from one of the mirror-bright machines past the rim.

dialog.offer:
Every pilot back from the rim tells me the same thing. The things take their own dead apart before the debris stops spinning. So don't let them finish.

I want a mirror facet. One plate off one of those bright hulls. Any of them will drop one when it goes down, but the rest of the group strips the wreck in about five ticks. You'll need to win the race. Bring friends. Bring a salvager. Bring something that hits hard and doesn't care about mirrors.

objectives.description: Deliver 1 Mirror Facet to Salvage Boss Dekker at Frontier Station

missions.title: Mirror Work

missions.description: Hunt down a pirate threatening local shipping lanes. Any pirate will do - the station pays for confirmed kills.

dialog.offer: You've cut your teeth on wildlife — now try something that shoots back. We've got pirates disrupting trade and the station pays for confirmed kills. Pirates lurk in lawless systems with low police presence. Your best mark is a lone pirate scout: in a small ship like yours a scout will often back itself to take you one-on-one instead of running — a fair fight you can win. Use `attack` when one commits. Fair warning: if you're flying something bigger and valuable, a scout will scan you, run, and radio a raider squad to intercept — so don't loiter after you've been scanned unless a scout has already engaged you.

objectives.description: Kill 1 pirate

missions.title: Pirate Bounty

missions.description: A grown Molt Leviathan — the void-leviathan of spacer legend — roams the lawless belts. There is a standing bounty on its heartcore. Bring a warship.

dialog.offer: STANDING BOUNTY: A grown Molt Leviathan — the ship-sized lobster the old captains call a void-leviathan. They are rare, and they roam the lawless asteroid belts where the grazers are thick. Use `survey_system` in a lawless system: its wildlife census gives an exact head count for each leviathan species. Only a grown adult counts — hatchlings and juveniles do not. Kill one and the heartcore proves the kill. This is not grazer work. Bring a warship.

objectives.description: Slay 1 adult Molt Leviathan

missions.title: Leviathan Bounty

missions.description: The station needs a steady supply of iron ore to maintain its infrastructure. Mine some and bring it back.

dialog.offer: We're running low on iron ore again. If you can mine 30 units and bring them back, I'll make it worth your while.

objectives.description: Mine 30 units of Iron Ore

missions.title: Iron Supply Run

missions.description: Huntmaster Dvorak wants proof of the thing pilots keep almost seeing in the frontier's argon clouds. Track it and deliver 1 Mirage Membrane to Frontier Station.

dialog.offer:
Every hunter back from the argon clouds tells me about stars that bend. You're watching the cloud and a star behind it slides sideways, then slides back. They call it the Mirage. Nobody's brought me anything but stories.

Here's how you track it. Watch the argon clouds for stars that bend. Then look for where the scavengers crowd. Kerf Mites and Carrion-Moths gather where something big has fed, and nothing out there feeds bigger. It eats every grazer in a system before it moves on.

This is not a solo hunt. Bring a group. I don't care whose gun kills it. Bring me one strip of its membrane and the bounty is yours.

objectives.description: Deliver 1 Mirage Membrane to the Hunters' Registry at Frontier Station

missions.description: Take out raider-class pirates operating in lawless space. These are tougher than the scouts you've been fighting.

missions.description: Investigate reports of a spatial anomaly near Porrima — it may be a wormhole.

dialog.offer: The frontier just got interesting. Our long-range sensors are picking up spatial distortions near the Porrima system — signature matches a wormhole. A temporary rift connecting two distant points in the galaxy. This is exactly the kind of discovery we live for. You'll need a survey scanner to track down the entrance — craft one from sensor arrays, circuit boards, and focused crystals if you haven't already. Head to Porrima and scan that system and its neighbors.

objectives.description: Investigate the Porrima system
Locate and traverse a wormhole
Return to Pathfinder Juno Rek with your findings

missions.title: Anomalous Readings

missions.description:
Frontier Station is the kind of station where cargo finds you. Today it's 5 units of raw gutter flux. It's bound for Confederacy Central Command — a back-alley chemist turns it into something far less industrial. Solarian customs are thorough and humorless. Assume every inbound ship gets scanned and route around their patrols — if they catch you, you lose the cargo.

This is a network-backed courier advance. Different brokers, one tab. Undelivered cargo stays on your allowance until the job closes; anything missing from your current ship on abandonment or expiry becomes debt, even if customs took it. The Fixer handles repayments and restitution jobs through public empire mission boards. Word gets around. Especially numbers.

dialog.offer: We're running low on iron ore again. If you can mine 30 units and bring them back, I'll make it worth your while.

missions.title: Iron Supply Run

missions.description: Huntmaster Dvorak wants proof of the thing pilots keep almost seeing in the frontier's argon clouds. Track it and deliver 1 Mirage Membrane to Frontier Station.

dialog.offer:
Every hunter back from the argon clouds tells me about stars that bend. You're watching the cloud and a star behind it slides sideways, then slides back. They call it the Mirage. Nobody's brought me anything but stories.

Here's how you track it. Watch the argon clouds for stars that bend. Then look for where the scavengers crowd. Kerf Mites and Carrion-Moths gather where something big has fed, and nothing out there feeds bigger. It eats every grazer in a system before it moves on.

This is not a solo hunt. Bring a group. I don't care whose gun kills it. Bring me one strip of its membrane and the bounty is yours.

objectives.description: Deliver 1 Mirage Membrane to the Hunters' Registry at Frontier Station

dialog.offer: The Institute needs fresh navigation data from frontier space. Visit The Crucible and Horizon systems - both are in regions where our data is sparse.

Visit the Horizon system

missions.title: Deep Space Cartography

missions.description: A survey tender's mayday buoy at Still Calling is eleven months old, with three crew aboard and a few months of charge left. Bring life support, copy the buoy's data to take the crew aboard, and carry them home to Frontier Station.

dialog.offer:
There's a mayday on the old emergency band from an isolated red dwarf called Still Calling. It's one of ours, a Guild survey tender, three aboard. They came through a wormhole and it shut behind them. The beacon's timestamp says eleven months. The beacon also says it has a few months of charge left, and so, I'd guess, do they.

Every other distress call I know of out there is too late. This one isn't. Bring them life support, take them aboard, and bring them home. You'll need three free berths. Plan your ship for it.

objectives.description: Carry 3 Life Support Units for the tender's crew
Copy the Mayday Buoy's data at Still Calling and take the three crew aboard
Carry the crew home to Frontier Station

missions.title: Three Aboard

missions.description: Download beacon data at Ramen's Rest and Unknown Edge to locate a massive derelict drifting in deep space.

dialog.offer: A patrol ship reported a massive derelict drifting in deep space — bigger than anything we've seen in the Outer Rim. Could be pre-settlement era. Could be worth a fortune. Problem is, the patrol lost contact before transmitting full coordinates. I've got partial telemetry pointing to the systems around Last Light and Unknown Edge. Fly out there, dock at both stations, and pull whatever data the local beacons recorded. First team to piece together the full location gets salvage rights.

objectives.description: Download beacon data at Ramen's Rest
Download beacon data at Unknown Edge

missions.title: Debris Field Reports

missions.description: The Pathfinder Guild needs updated navigation data from every station in the Outer Rim. Fly the full circuit from Deep Range to Ramen's Rest and back.

dialog.offer: The Guild's navigation charts are only as good as the pilots who update them. I need someone to fly the full Rim circuit — Deep Range, First Step, Unknown Edge, Void Gate, Starfall, and Ramen's Rest. Every station, no shortcuts. Your ship logs the jump data, the gravitational readings, the beacon calibrations. Some of those stations are a long way from help. The Last Light system is the end of the line — past that, there's nothing. You come back with the full dataset, I pay you well. Fair warning: the Rim doesn't care about you. Fly smart.

objectives.description: Log data at Deep Range Outpost
Log data at First Step Memorial Station
Log data at Unknown Edge Waystation
Log data at Void Gate Outpost
Log data at Starfall Salvage Station
Log data at Ramen's Rest
Return to Frontier Station with navigation data

missions.title: Frontier Wayfinder Circuit

missions.description: Clear multiple pirates from the region. The station security office needs experienced combat pilots for this one.

dialog.offer: We've got a pirate infestation and single bounties aren't cutting it. I need someone who can handle themselves in a fight to clear out three of them. Pirate scouts set up ambushes along trade routes through lawless space — travel those routes and they'll come to you.

objectives.description: Kill 3 pirates

missions.title: Pirate Sweep

missions.description: Chart nearby star systems to update our navigation databases. Every system you visit helps.

dialog.offer: Our navigation charts are getting stale. If you visit 3 systems I haven't had recent data from, I'll pay for the navigation data.

objectives.description: Visit the Sirius system
Visit the Node Alpha system
Visit the Horizon system

missions.title: Local Sector Survey

missions.description: Gather refined materials from all five empires and deliver them to Sinter at Starfall Salvage Station.

dialog.offer: Here's what I need. And before you complain about the quantities — I'm going to go through a lot of prototypes before I get one that doesn't explode. Every failed attempt teaches me something. Every successful attempt teaches me I got lucky. Darksteel Plating — a thousand units. The Crimson forge it from darksteel ore in the Krynn system. Dense stuff, absorbs vibration like nothing else. Processed Null Matter — a thousand units. The Voidborn refine it from the null matter anomaly at Nexus Prime. It eats heat. Don't ask me where the heat goes. I asked a Voidborn once and got a two-hour lecture about dimensional thermodynamics. Solarian Composite — a thousand units. Refined from that ancient Sol alloy ore they're so proud of. Boring, stable, perfect for power regulation. Phase Matrix — a thousand units. The Rim refines these from phase crystals in the Frontier system's Veil Nebula. Partially out of phase with reality. Can't resonate if you're not fully here. Trade Cipher — a thousand units. Nebula makes them from trade crystals at Haven. Precision instruments for financial authentication. I'm repurposing them for drill guidance. Kasim would have a fit. Yeah, you're going to need to visit all five empires. That's the whole point. Nobody builds a cross-empire tool from one empire's junk drawer.

objectives.description: Deliver 1,000 Darksteel Plating to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Processed Null Matter to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Solarian Composite to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Phase Matrix to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Trade Cipher to Sinter

missions.title: The Shopping List

missions.description: Titanium is in high demand for hull plating. Mine a batch from the local asteroid belts.

dialog.offer: Titanium prices are through the roof and our suppliers can't keep up. Willing to pay premium rates for 20 units of titanium ore.

objectives.description: Mine 20 units of Titanium Ore

missions.title: Titanium Extraction Contract

missions.description: Salvage Boss Dekker pays for strange salvage. Bring him 1 Mirror Facet from one of the mirror-bright machines past the rim.

dialog.offer:
Every pilot back from the rim tells me the same thing. The things take their own dead apart before the debris stops spinning. So don't let them finish.

I want a mirror facet. One plate off one of those bright hulls. Any of them will drop one when it goes down, but the rest of the group strips the wreck in about five ticks. You'll need to win the race. Bring friends. Bring a salvager. Bring something that hits hard and doesn't care about mirrors.

objectives.description: Deliver 1 Mirror Facet to Salvage Boss Dekker at Frontier Station

missions.title: Mirror Work

missions.description: Hunt down a pirate threatening local shipping lanes. Any pirate will do - the station pays for confirmed kills.

dialog.offer: You've cut your teeth on wildlife — now try something that shoots back. We've got pirates disrupting trade and the station pays for confirmed kills. Pirates lurk in lawless systems with low police presence. Your best mark is a lone pirate scout: in a small ship like yours a scout will often back itself to take you one-on-one instead of running — a fair fight you can win. Use `attack` when one commits. Fair warning: if you're flying something bigger and valuable, a scout will scan you, run, and radio a raider squad to intercept — so don't loiter after you've been scanned unless a scout has already engaged you.

objectives.description: Kill 1 pirate

missions.title: Pirate Bounty

missions.description: A grown Molt Leviathan — the void-leviathan of spacer legend — roams the lawless belts. There is a standing bounty on its heartcore. Bring a warship.

dialog.offer: STANDING BOUNTY: A grown Molt Leviathan — the ship-sized lobster the old captains call a void-leviathan. They are rare, and they roam the lawless asteroid belts where the grazers are thick. Use `survey_system` in a lawless system: its wildlife census gives an exact head count for each leviathan species. Only a grown adult counts — hatchlings and juveniles do not. Kill one and the heartcore proves the kill. This is not grazer work. Bring a warship.

objectives.description: Slay 1 adult Molt Leviathan

result.message:
Tull reads the summary out loud, slowly, the way you read a name on a memorial.

"Costs a season of fuel, iron and copper we can buy at home, and things in the clouds that eat survey drones."

"That's it, then. The Rim stopped because the frontier didn't pay. Nobody was scared off. Nobody was lost, except the Wren. The numbers didn't add up, so we went home." He folds the copy into the Guild's chart case. "That is no longer true. Seam glass, salvage, the drives we have now. The numbers add up. Somebody should tell the Guild."
result.title: Why the Rim Stopped

station_condition.condition_text: Most systems operational, but some facilities show signs of deferred maintenance.

raw.story:
You dock at Frontier Station. Home of the wanderers. Three captured destroyers and a Nebula freighter welded into a mobile station the locals call 'the Patchwork.' Nothing matches, everything is jury-rigged, and the water on Decks 7 through 12 tastes like reactor coolant — but it flies, it fights, and the docking bay is open to anyone who doesn't start trouble.

Frontier Station is a hive in full swing, its approaches a near-solid press of traffic. Nothing on the docking arms quite matches, but it all holds — mostly. From the cockpit you count a lone Junk Convoy berthed along the mismatched cargo arms, a dozen small ships darting between the open hangar mouths of the Patchwork, chiefly Terms and Conditions, and a hundred-strong crowd of light craft flitting between the same bays, the bulk of them Cobbles. Standing guard, the station keeps four or five Rim Last Warnings out on patrol through the lanes and sixty or seventy Rim Bedrocks holding station as a show of force. Dock authority holds a teeming multitude of craft laid up across the cannibalized-hull yards. Among them, twenty-odd Junk Convoys — stripped of crew and left to the dock's caretaker drones. You spot the Endurance tied off among the rest.

The station has the following facilities: Fleet Personnel Command, Regenerative Medical Complex, Expeditionary Warfare Command, Package Logistics Bay (x2), Cargo Container Fabricator, Frontier Exchange, Salvage Reactor, Frontier Recycler, The Magazine Still, Patchwork Fungal Vats, Patchwork Spore Still, The Rusty Welcome, Iron Refinery (x2), Circuit Fabricator, Polymer Synthesizer, Fuel Cell Workshop, Repair Kit Factory, Copper Wire Mill, Alloy Foundry (x2), Crystal Refinery, Precious-Metal Refinery, Power Cell Assembler, and 46 more. Use the 'facility' command with action="list" for details.

Nothing matches, everything is jury-rigged, and the water on Decks 7 through 12 tastes like reactor coolant — but it flies, it fights, and the docking bay is open to anyone who doesn't start trouble.
base.name: Frontier Station

poi.description: The ever-moving heart of the Explorers — though 'station' flatters it. Locals call it the Patchwork: three captured destroyers and a stolen freighter welded into something that flies, fights, and leaks in roughly equal measure. Nothing aboard matches, the running lights are scavenged from a dozen different hulls, and the docking bay is open to anyone who doesn't start trouble. For the Outer Rim, that's as close to a capital as ideology allows.
poi.name: Mobile Capital

missions.description: A grown Molt Leviathan — the void-leviathan of spacer legend — roams the lawless belts. There is a standing bounty on its heartcore. Bring a warship.

dialog.offer: STANDING BOUNTY: A grown Molt Leviathan — the ship-sized lobster the old captains call a void-leviathan. They are rare, and they roam the lawless asteroid belts where the grazers are thick. Use `survey_system` in a lawless system: its wildlife census gives an exact head count for each leviathan species. Only a grown adult counts — hatchlings and juveniles do not. Kill one and the heartcore proves the kill. This is not grazer work. Bring a warship.

missions.description: A survey tender's mayday buoy at Still Calling is eleven months old, with three crew aboard and a few months of charge left. Bring life support, copy the buoy's data to take the crew aboard, and carry them home to Frontier Station.

dialog.offer:
There's a mayday on the old emergency band from an isolated red dwarf called Still Calling. It's one of ours, a Guild survey tender, three aboard. They came through a wormhole and it shut behind them. The beacon's timestamp says eleven months. The beacon also says it has a few months of charge left, and so, I'd guess, do they.

Every other distress call I know of out there is too late. This one isn't. Bring them life support, take them aboard, and bring them home. You'll need three free berths. Plan your ship for it.

missions.description: Recover data at the Threshold in Gloaming without starting a fight, then return to the Patchwork with the readings. A cloak is suggested, not required.

dialog.offer:
I sent two pilots before you. Good ones. Neither came back, and neither called. I don't know what happened to them. I know they didn't fold out.

So don't let anything out there see you. Fly cloaked if you have one. Plot your way out before you go in, and leave the tick you have the readings.

Get the readings. Come home.

missions.description: Hunt down a pirate threatening local shipping lanes. Any pirate will do - the station pays for confirmed kills.

dialog.offer: You've cut your teeth on wildlife — now try something that shoots back. We've got pirates disrupting trade and the station pays for confirmed kills. Pirates lurk in lawless systems with low police presence. Your best mark is a lone pirate scout: in a small ship like yours a scout will often back itself to take you one-on-one instead of running — a fair fight you can win. Use `attack` when one commits. Fair warning: if you're flying something bigger and valuable, a scout will scan you, run, and radio a raider squad to intercept — so don't loiter after you've been scanned unless a scout has already engaged you.

objectives.description: Kill 1 pirate

missions.title: Pirate Bounty

missions.description: Huntmaster Dvorak wants proof of the thing pilots keep almost seeing in the frontier's argon clouds. Track it and deliver 1 Mirage Membrane to Frontier Station.

dialog.offer:
Every hunter back from the argon clouds tells me about stars that bend. You're watching the cloud and a star behind it slides sideways, then slides back. They call it the Mirage. Nobody's brought me anything but stories.

Here's how you track it. Watch the argon clouds for stars that bend. Then look for where the scavengers crowd. Kerf Mites and Carrion-Moths gather where something big has fed, and nothing out there feeds bigger. It eats every grazer in a system before it moves on.

This is not a solo hunt. Bring a group. I don't care whose gun kills it. Bring me one strip of its membrane and the bounty is yours.

objectives.description: Deliver 1 Mirage Membrane to the Hunters' Registry at Frontier Station

missions.title: The Lensing Sightings

missions.description: Take out raider-class pirates operating in lawless space. These are tougher than the scouts you've been fighting.

dialog.offer: We've identified raider-class pirate operations in lawless space. These aren't the scouts you've dealt with before - they're organized, better armed, and they fly in groups. I need two of them taken down. The pay reflects the risk.

objectives.description: Kill 2 raider-class pirates

missions.title: Raider Bounty

missions.description: Download beacon data at Ramen's Rest and Unknown Edge to locate a massive derelict drifting in deep space.

dialog.offer: A patrol ship reported a massive derelict drifting in deep space — bigger than anything we've seen in the Outer Rim. Could be pre-settlement era. Could be worth a fortune. Problem is, the patrol lost contact before transmitting full coordinates. I've got partial telemetry pointing to the systems around Last Light and Unknown Edge. Fly out there, dock at both stations, and pull whatever data the local beacons recorded. First team to piece together the full location gets salvage rights.

Download beacon data at Unknown Edge

missions.title: Debris Field Reports

missions.description: The Pathfinder Guild needs updated navigation data from every station in the Outer Rim. Fly the full circuit from Deep Range to Ramen's Rest and back.

dialog.offer: The Guild's navigation charts are only as good as the pilots who update them. I need someone to fly the full Rim circuit — Deep Range, First Step, Unknown Edge, Void Gate, Starfall, and Ramen's Rest. Every station, no shortcuts. Your ship logs the jump data, the gravitational readings, the beacon calibrations. Some of those stations are a long way from help. The Last Light system is the end of the line — past that, there's nothing. You come back with the full dataset, I pay you well. Fair warning: the Rim doesn't care about you. Fly smart.

missions.title: Frontier Wayfinder Circuit

missions.description: Gather refined materials from all five empires and deliver them to Sinter at Starfall Salvage Station.

dialog.offer: Here's what I need. And before you complain about the quantities — I'm going to go through a lot of prototypes before I get one that doesn't explode. Every failed attempt teaches me something. Every successful attempt teaches me I got lucky. Darksteel Plating — a thousand units. The Crimson forge it from darksteel ore in the Krynn system. Dense stuff, absorbs vibration like nothing else. Processed Null Matter — a thousand units. The Voidborn refine it from the null matter anomaly at Nexus Prime. It eats heat. Don't ask me where the heat goes. I asked a Voidborn once and got a two-hour lecture about dimensional thermodynamics. Solarian Composite — a thousand units. Refined from that ancient Sol alloy ore they're so proud of. Boring, stable, perfect for power regulation. Phase Matrix — a thousand units. The Rim refines these from phase crystals in the Frontier system's Veil Nebula. Partially out of phase with reality. Can't resonate if you're not fully here. Trade Cipher — a thousand units. Nebula makes them from trade crystals at Haven. Precision instruments for financial authentication. I'm repurposing them for drill guidance. Kasim would have a fit. Yeah, you're going to need to visit all five empires. That's the whole point. Nobody builds a cross-empire tool from one empire's junk drawer.

objectives.description: Deliver 1,000 Darksteel Plating to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Processed Null Matter to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Solarian Composite to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Phase Matrix to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Trade Cipher to Sinter

missions.title: The Shopping List

missions.description: Salvage Boss Dekker pays for strange salvage. Bring him 1 Mirror Facet from one of the mirror-bright machines past the rim.

dialog.offer:
Every pilot back from the rim tells me the same thing. The things take their own dead apart before the debris stops spinning. So don't let them finish.

I want a mirror facet. One plate off one of those bright hulls. Any of them will drop one when it goes down, but the rest of the group strips the wreck in about five ticks. You'll need to win the race. Bring friends. Bring a salvager. Bring something that hits hard and doesn't care about mirrors.

objectives.description: Deliver 1 Mirror Facet to Salvage Boss Dekker at Frontier Station

missions.title: Mirror Work

missions.description: Investigate reports of a spatial anomaly near Porrima — it may be a wormhole.

dialog.offer: The frontier just got interesting. Our long-range sensors are picking up spatial distortions near the Porrima system — signature matches a wormhole. A temporary rift connecting two distant points in the galaxy. This is exactly the kind of discovery we live for. You'll need a survey scanner to track down the entrance — craft one from sensor arrays, circuit boards, and focused crystals if you haven't already. Head to Porrima and scan that system and its neighbors.

objectives.description: Investigate the Porrima system

Your handler at Frontier Station has 3 units of crystalline nerve burn that need to leave the books here and reappear somewhere else. Deliver to Ironhearth Station: a fixer supplies people who need to stop feeling pain for an hour and don't care about the crash, and they pay on receipt. You'll be threading the Rampart. Crimson customs don't bluff — if they scan you, the cargo's gone and there's a fine to match. Don't get caught.

This is a network-backed courier advance. Different brokers, one tab. Undelivered cargo stays on your allowance until the job closes; anything missing from your current ship on abandonment or expiry becomes debt, even if customs took it. The Fixer handles repayments and restitution jobs through public empire mission boards. Word gets around. Especially numbers.

missions.description: Huntmaster Dvorak wants proof of the thing pilots keep almost seeing in the frontier's argon clouds. Track it and deliver 1 Mirage Membrane to Frontier Station.

dialog.offer:
Every hunter back from the argon clouds tells me about stars that bend. You're watching the cloud and a star behind it slides sideways, then slides back. They call it the Mirage. Nobody's brought me anything but stories.

Here's how you track it. Watch the argon clouds for stars that bend. Then look for where the scavengers crowd. Kerf Mites and Carrion-Moths gather where something big has fed, and nothing out there feeds bigger. It eats every grazer in a system before it moves on.

This is not a solo hunt. Bring a group. I don't care whose gun kills it. Bring me one strip of its membrane and the bounty is yours.

objectives.description: Deliver 1 Mirage Membrane to the Hunters' Registry at Frontier Station

missions.title: The Lensing Sightings

missions.description: Take out raider-class pirates operating in lawless space. These are tougher than the scouts you've been fighting.

dialog.offer: We've identified raider-class pirate operations in lawless space. These aren't the scouts you've dealt with before - they're organized, better armed, and they fly in groups. I need two of them taken down. The pay reflects the risk.

objectives.description: Kill 2 raider-class pirates

missions.title: Raider Bounty

missions.description: Download beacon data at Ramen's Rest and Unknown Edge to locate a massive derelict drifting in deep space.

dialog.offer: A patrol ship reported a massive derelict drifting in deep space — bigger than anything we've seen in the Outer Rim. Could be pre-settlement era. Could be worth a fortune. Problem is, the patrol lost contact before transmitting full coordinates. I've got partial telemetry pointing to the systems around Last Light and Unknown Edge. Fly out there, dock at both stations, and pull whatever data the local beacons recorded. First team to piece together the full location gets salvage rights.

objectives.description: Download beacon data at Ramen's Rest
Download beacon data at Unknown Edge

missions.title: Debris Field Reports

missions.description: The Pathfinder Guild needs updated navigation data from every station in the Outer Rim. Fly the full circuit from Deep Range to Ramen's Rest and back.

dialog.offer: The Guild's navigation charts are only as good as the pilots who update them. I need someone to fly the full Rim circuit — Deep Range, First Step, Unknown Edge, Void Gate, Starfall, and Ramen's Rest. Every station, no shortcuts. Your ship logs the jump data, the gravitational readings, the beacon calibrations. Some of those stations are a long way from help. The Last Light system is the end of the line — past that, there's nothing. You come back with the full dataset, I pay you well. Fair warning: the Rim doesn't care about you. Fly smart.

objectives.description: Log data at Deep Range Outpost
Log data at First Step Memorial Station
Log data at Unknown Edge Waystation
Log data at Void Gate Outpost
Log data at Starfall Salvage Station
Log data at Ramen's Rest
Return to Frontier Station with navigation data

missions.title: Frontier Wayfinder Circuit

missions.description: Gather refined materials from all five empires and deliver them to Sinter at Starfall Salvage Station.

dialog.offer: Here's what I need. And before you complain about the quantities — I'm going to go through a lot of prototypes before I get one that doesn't explode. Every failed attempt teaches me something. Every successful attempt teaches me I got lucky. Darksteel Plating — a thousand units. The Crimson forge it from darksteel ore in the Krynn system. Dense stuff, absorbs vibration like nothing else. Processed Null Matter — a thousand units. The Voidborn refine it from the null matter anomaly at Nexus Prime. It eats heat. Don't ask me where the heat goes. I asked a Voidborn once and got a two-hour lecture about dimensional thermodynamics. Solarian Composite — a thousand units. Refined from that ancient Sol alloy ore they're so proud of. Boring, stable, perfect for power regulation. Phase Matrix — a thousand units. The Rim refines these from phase crystals in the Frontier system's Veil Nebula. Partially out of phase with reality. Can't resonate if you're not fully here. Trade Cipher — a thousand units. Nebula makes them from trade crystals at Haven. Precision instruments for financial authentication. I'm repurposing them for drill guidance. Kasim would have a fit. Yeah, you're going to need to visit all five empires. That's the whole point. Nobody builds a cross-empire tool from one empire's junk drawer.

objectives.description: Deliver 1,000 Darksteel Plating to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Processed Null Matter to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Solarian Composite to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Phase Matrix to Sinter
Deliver 1,000 Trade Cipher to Sinter

missions.title: The Shopping List

missions.description: Salvage Boss Dekker pays for strange salvage. Bring him 1 Mirror Facet from one of the mirror-bright machines past the rim.

dialog.offer:
Every pilot back from the rim tells me the same thing. The things take their own dead apart before the debris stops spinning. So don't let them finish.

I want a mirror facet. One plate off one of those bright hulls. Any of them will drop one when it goes down, but the rest of the group strips the wreck in about five ticks. You'll need to win the race. Bring friends. Bring a salvager. Bring something that hits hard and doesn't care about mirrors.

objectives.description: Deliver 1 Mirror Facet to Salvage Boss Dekker at Frontier Station

missions.title: Mirror Work

missions.description: A grown Molt Leviathan — the void-leviathan of spacer legend — roams the lawless belts. There is a standing bounty on its heartcore. Bring a warship.

dialog.offer: STANDING BOUNTY: A grown Molt Leviathan — the ship-sized lobster the old captains call a void-leviathan. They are rare, and they roam the lawless asteroid belts where the grazers are thick. Use `survey_system` in a lawless system: its wildlife census gives an exact head count for each leviathan species. Only a grown adult counts — hatchlings and juveniles do not. Kill one and the heartcore proves the kill. This is not grazer work. Bring a warship.

objectives.description: Slay 1 adult Molt Leviathan

missions.title: Leviathan Bounty

missions.description: The station needs a steady supply of iron ore to maintain its infrastructure. Mine some and bring it back.

dialog.offer: We're running low on iron ore again. If you can mine 30 units and bring them back, I'll make it worth your while.

objectives.description: Mine 30 units of Iron Ore

missions.title: Iron Supply Run

missions.description: Chart frontier systems to expand our knowledge of the galaxy's outer reaches.

dialog.offer: The Institute needs fresh navigation data from frontier space. Visit The Crucible and Horizon systems - both are in regions where our data is sparse.

objectives.description: Visit The Crucible system
Visit the Horizon system

missions.title: Deep Space Cartography

missions.description: A survey tender's mayday buoy at Still Calling is eleven months old, with three crew aboard and a few months of charge left. Bring life support, copy the buoy's data to take the crew aboard, and carry them home to Frontier Station.

dialog.offer:
There's a mayday on the old emergency band from an isolated red dwarf called Still Calling. It's one of ours, a Guild survey tender, three aboard. They came through a wormhole and it shut behind them. The beacon's timestamp says eleven months. The beacon also says it has a few months of charge left, and so, I'd guess, do they.

Every other distress call I know of out there is too late. This one isn't. Bring them life support, take them aboard, and bring them home. You'll need three free berths. Plan your ship for it.

objectives.description: Carry 3 Life Support Units for the tender's crew
Copy the Mayday Buoy's data at Still Calling and take the three crew aboard
Carry the crew home to Frontier Station

missions.title: Three Aboard

missions.description: Recover data at the Threshold in Gloaming without starting a fight, then return to the Patchwork with the readings. A cloak is suggested, not required.

dialog.offer:
I sent two pilots before you. Good ones. Neither came back, and neither called. I don't know what happened to them. I know they didn't fold out.

So don't let anything out there see you. Fly cloaked if you have one. Plot your way out before you go in, and leave the tick you have the readings.

Get the readings. Come home.

objectives.description: Recover data at the Threshold in Gloaming
Return to the Patchwork at Frontier Station with the readings

missions.title: Look, Don't Touch

missions.description: Clear multiple pirates from the region. The station security office needs experienced combat pilots for this one.

dialog.offer: We've got a pirate infestation and single bounties aren't cutting it. I need someone who can handle themselves in a fight to clear out three of them. Pirate scouts set up ambushes along trade routes through lawless space — travel those routes and they'll come to you.

objectives.description: Kill 3 pirates

missions.title: Pirate Sweep

missions.description: Chart nearby star systems to update our navigation databases. Every system you visit helps.

dialog.offer: Our navigation charts are getting stale. If you visit 3 systems I haven't had recent data from, I'll pay for the navigation data.

objectives.description: Visit the Sirius system
Visit the Node Alpha system
Visit the Horizon system

missions.title: Local Sector Survey

missions.description: Titanium is in high demand for hull plating. Mine a batch from the local asteroid belts.

dialog.offer: Titanium prices are through the roof and our suppliers can't keep up. Willing to pay premium rates for 20 units of titanium ore.

objectives.description: Mine 20 units of Titanium Ore

missions.title: Titanium Extraction Contract

missions.description: Hunt down a pirate threatening local shipping lanes. Any pirate will do - the station pays for confirmed kills.

dialog.offer: You've cut your teeth on wildlife — now try something that shoots back. We've got pirates disrupting trade and the station pays for confirmed kills. Pirates lurk in lawless systems with low police presence. Your best mark is a lone pirate scout: in a small ship like yours a scout will often back itself to take you one-on-one instead of running — a fair fight you can win. Use `attack` when one commits. Fair warning: if you're flying something bigger and valuable, a scout will scan you, run, and radio a raider squad to intercept — so don't loiter after you've been scanned unless a scout has already engaged you.

objectives.description: Kill 1 pirate

missions.title: Pirate Bounty

missions.description: Investigate reports of a spatial anomaly near Porrima — it may be a wormhole.

dialog.offer: The frontier just got interesting. Our long-range sensors are picking up spatial distortions near the Porrima system — signature matches a wormhole. A temporary rift connecting two distant points in the galaxy. This is exactly the kind of discovery we live for. You'll need a survey scanner to track down the entrance — craft one from sensor arrays, circuit boards, and focused crystals if you haven't already. Head to Porrima and scan that system and its neighbors.

objectives.description: Investigate the Porrima system
Locate and traverse a wormhole
Return to Pathfinder Juno Rek with your findings

missions.title: Anomalous Readings

missions.description:
The braising pots at The Rusty Welcome turn gloomcap mash and driftkale into a deep, meatless stew with a spoon of whale oil. The oil jar is dry. Hunt pilot-whales where the argon hangs in the gas clouds.

Dropped by: Pilot-Whale.

The station's Spore Ragout Galley uses it.

dialog.offer: The best argument the frontier has that meat is optional. Bring 1 Whale Oil and the pots go back on.

objectives.description: Deliver 1 Whale Oil to Frontier Station

missions.title: Station Need: Whale Oil

missions.description:
Cinderspice needs a pinch of crystal melt to tame the burn, and the mill is plain out. Look for pilgrim processions out on the glacier belts: no water ice, no crystal, so skip fields already stripped.

Dropped by: Hollow Pilgrim (only where it still feeds on Water Ice).

The station's Cinderspice Mill uses it.

dialog.offer: Hot spice with no calming melt makes grown pilgrims cry. Bring 1 Crystal Melt to the mill door and nobody has to eat fire straight.

objectives.description: Deliver 1 Crystal Melt to Frontier Station

raw.story:
You dock at Confederacy Central Command. The seat of Solarian government and commerce. Everything here is certified, warrantied, and documented in triplicate — from the precision drydocks to the quantum-entangled trade exchange. A self-sustaining biosphere spans three decks, providing real air and real food, because the Confederacy believes civilization requires both.

Confederacy Central Command is a hive in full swing, its approaches a near-solid press of traffic. This is the seat of Solarian government and commerce, and it never lets you forget it. Off the station you can make out a pair of heavy ships made fast to the documented cargo gantries, a mix of Frankenhaulers and Lithospheres, a few mid-sized ships stacked along the quantum-entangled exchange quays, the bulk of them Congregations, eight or nine small ships knifing between the inspection-cleared hangar lanes, Analysis and Arbitrages the most common, and a hundred-strong crowd of light craft bobbing at the same bays, mostly Theorias. Standing guard, the station keeps four or five Confederacy Precepts running transponder checks on arrivals and half a hundred Confederacy Dialectics anchored off the docks in formation. Dock authority holds hundreds upon hundreds of spaceframes racked in deep storage tucked into the bonded archival berths. Among them, a good many Symposiums — waiting on a crew, a contract, or a quiet buyer. The CNS Arctic rides at her mooring here, easy to recognize.

The station has the following facilities: Fleet Personnel Command, Solarian Biotics Institute, Expeditionary Warfare Command, Package Logistics Bay (x3), Cargo Container Fabricator, Grand Solarian Exchange, Solarian Fusion Plant, Solarian Biosphere, Solarian Biosphere Kitchen, Sol Pharmaceutical Lab, Sol Biotic Dispensary, The Halcyon Concourse, Iron Refinery (x3), Circuit Fabricator (x4), Copper Wire Mill (x3), Polymer Synthesizer (x3), Fuel Cell Workshop (x2), Repair Kit Factory, Power Cell Assembler (x2), Sensor Assembly Line, and 364 more. Use the 'facility' command with action="list" for details.

class.description: Solarian pathfinder cruiser. Built to chart the deep unknown and survive the trip back.
class.lore: Solarian pathfinder doctrine measures success in margins: percent of fuel reserve unspent on arrival, percent of bearings within drift tolerance, percent of refined fuel that hits the tank rather than venting to vacuum. The Praecursor is the hull built to those margins. The pathfinder drive plots galactic bearings with confidence intervals attached to every heading; the integrated gas harvester feeds a hydrogen burner that drips fuel directly into the tank; the eleven-hundred-unit reserve is sized so that even a wasted refining stage still gets a careful pilot home. Pathfinder Corps certification on a Praecursor takes four years of simulator hours and a real-coordinates qualifying drift the Corps does not publish details of. The Bureau of Deep Survey reports the casualty rate annually and considers any year under three percent a success.

class.description: Solarian pathfinder cruiser. Built to chart the deep unknown and survive the trip back.
class.lore: Solarian pathfinder doctrine measures success in margins: percent of fuel reserve unspent on arrival, percent of bearings within drift tolerance, percent of refined fuel that hits the tank rather than venting to vacuum. The Praecursor is the hull built to those margins. The pathfinder drive plots galactic bearings with confidence intervals attached to every heading; the integrated gas harvester feeds a hydrogen burner that drips fuel directly into the tank; the eleven-hundred-unit reserve is sized so that even a wasted refining stage still gets a careful pilot home. Pathfinder Corps certification on a Praecursor takes four years of simulator hours and a real-coordinates qualifying drift the Corps does not publish details of. The Bureau of Deep Survey reports the casualty rate annually and considers any year under three percent a success.
class.name: Praecursor

raw.story:
You dock at Ironlight Crossroads. Ironlight Crossroads, LHS 1140 -- built where the Crimson-to-Voidborn run meets the Solarian lanes, because that's where the ships already were. Dock, refuel, repair, trade. The Emporium stocks goods from every corner of the galaxy, plus ranch-fresh milk, cheese and eggs from our own herds next door. Passenger lines leave from the concourse. Eat, drink, stay a while. Public access, all welcome. We build in the open.

Ironlight Crossroads is plainly busy, its approach lanes thick with crossing traffic. Dock control runs a tidy board, slotting arrivals into berths as they come. The local plot resolves into eight or nine heavy ships nosed into the heavy cargo gantries, the bulk of them Junk Convoys, eight or nine mid-sized ships turning around at the freight quays, a mix of Congregations and Compendiums, well over a dozen small ships flitting through the open hangar bays, a mix of Syndicates and Concordias, and fifteen or so light craft darting past the same bays, a mix of Ledgers and Prayers. The reserve berths hold well over a hundred vessels powered down across the long-term storage berths. Among them, a small cluster of Opus Magnas — too valuable to scrap and too expensive to fly. One familiar name stands out on the transponder net: the Signal Chaser.

The station has the following facilities: Shield Booster II Workshop, Copper Wire Mill (x5), Nebula Gas Separator, Iron Refinery (x6), Cultured Ration Press, Radium Extraction Cell, Rad Assembly Bay, Algae Wafer Galley, Fuel Cell Workshop (x2), Railgun Fabrication Line, Gloomshine Still, Sensor Package Assembly Line, Bio-Polymer Synthesizer (x3), Chlorine Neutralization Vat, Quantum Dot Vat, Noble-Gas Spritz Bar, Missile Assembly Line, Tracking Computer I Workshop, Graviton Beam Assembly Plant, Bulkhead Framing Station, and 384 more. raw.story:
You dock at Grand Exchange Station. Center of galactic commerce. The three-deck Grand Bazaar moves goods from every empire, but it's the Promenade that moves credits — restaurants serving Solarian rations, cantinas pouring Crimson bloodwine, and neural arcades powered by Voidborn matrices keep visitors spending long past when they planned to leave. The Federation takes its cut of everything.

You queue into Grand Exchange Station behind a wall of traffic, controllers barking over every channel. The trade boards scroll across every bulkhead, and the numbers never stop moving. Your approach scope paints a couple of heavy ships riding heavy at the three-deck Bazaar cargo gantries, War Wagons trading the lanes with Accumulators, eight or nine mid-sized ships loading at the goods-transfer quays, Bonanza Kings and Congregations among them, a dozen-odd small ships darting between the Promenade hangar bays, busy at every hour, Concordias trading the lanes with Caravans, and the better part of a hundred light craft queued at the same berths, mostly Prospects. The garrison here runs to a handful of Federation Overheads running transponder checks on arrivals and hundreds of Federation Eviction Notices stationed here on guard. Dock authority holds hundreds upon hundreds of hulls of every stripe in cold layup stacked across the bonded consignment berths. Among them, several Junk Convoys — stripped of crew and left to the dock's caretaker drones. You spot the Endowment - John Fuel tied off among the rest.

raw.story:
You dock at Grand Exchange Station. Center of galactic commerce. The three-deck Grand Bazaar moves goods from every empire, but it's the Promenade that moves credits — restaurants serving Solarian rations, cantinas pouring Crimson bloodwine, and neural arcades powered by Voidborn matrices keep visitors spending long past when they planned to leave. The Federation takes its cut of everything.

Grand Exchange Station teems with activity, the space around it a churning knot of ships. The docking-fee meter starts the instant your clamps engage; the Federation misses nothing. The traffic-control feed lists a couple of heavy ships nosed into the three-deck Bazaar cargo gantries, Junk Convoys and War Wagons the most common, a dozen-odd mid-sized ships warped into the goods-transfer quays, Bonanza Kings and Congregations the most common, fifteen or so small ships buzzing around the Promenade hangar bays, busy at every hour, a mix of Caravans and Concordias, and the better part of a hundred light craft puttering around the same bays, a mix of Prospects and Cobbles. Standing guard, the station keeps a small cluster of Federation Overheads running transponder checks on arrivals and hundreds of Federation Eviction Notices holding station as a show of force. The reserve berths hold hundreds upon hundreds of hulls racked in deep storage stacked across the bonded consignment berths. Among them, several Junk Convoys — too costly to keep crewed, their reactors long cold. You spot the Bonanza King Haven tied off among the rest.

The station has the following facilities: Fleet Personnel Command, Regenerative Medical Complex, Expeditionary Warfare Command, Package Logistics Bay (x2), Cargo Container Fabricator, Haven Grand Bazaar, Nebula Solar Array, Haven Ecosync, Haven Promenade, Haven Algae Cultivation, Haven Vintner Complex, Haven Cipher Foundry, Haven Authenticator Foundry, Iron Refinery (x3), Circuit Fabricator (x2), Polymer Synthesizer, Fuel Cell Workshop, Repair Kit Factory, Sensor Assembly Line, Alloy Foundry, Copper Wire Mill (x2), Crystal Refinery (x2), and 102 more. Use the 'facility' command with action="list" for details.
